BEGIN
--Employee_HomeBranch(m:n) - Appends

DELETE FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Employees_HomeBranch` WHERE TRUE;
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Employees_HomeBranch` (
	SELECT Employee_Number as Emp_id,
	Branch as branch_id,
	branch_transfer_date,
	supervisor_id,
    Effective_Date_for_Current_Position as supervisor_eff_date,
	job_code,
	Time_in_Job_profile_start_date
	FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_RNA_Employees` a 
	WHERE TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(a.gcp_updated,1,19)) >= TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE())
); 

DELETE FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Employees_HomeBranch` WHERE TRUE;
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Employees_HomeBranch` (
	SELECT
	  S1.Emp_id,
	  S1.branch_id,
	  S1.branch_transfer_date,
	  S1.supervisor_id,
	  S1.supervisor_eff_date,
	  S1.job_code,
	  S1.Time_in_Job_profile_start_date,
	  `bidata-sharedus-production.Functions.convertStringToHashkey`(CONCAT(S1.Emp_id,S1.branch_id,S1.supervisor_id,S1.job_code)) AS HASHDIFF,
	  'RNA_Employees' AS SRC_SYSTEM,
	  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS CRE_DATE
	FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Employees_HomeBranch` S1 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Employees_HomeBranch` S3 
	ON S1.Emp_id = S3.Emp_id 
	WHERE `bidata-sharedus-production.Functions.convertStringToHashkey`(CONCAT(S1.Emp_id,S1.branch_id,S1.supervisor_id,S1.job_code)) != S3.HASHDIFF 
	AND S3.SRC_SYSTEM = 'RNA_Employees' 
); 

INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Employees_HomeBranch` (
		SELECT A.* FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Employees_HomeBranch` A LEFT OUTER JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S3.Employees_HomeBranch` B ON  A.HASHDIFF = B.HASHDIFF  
		WHERE A.CRE_DATE >= TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE()) AND B.HASHDIFF IS NULL
);

--rehire_details(m:n) - Appends

DELETE FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.rehire_details` WHERE TRUE;
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.rehire_details` (
	SELECT Employee_Number as Emp_id,
	hire_date,
	termination_date
	FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_RNA_Employees` a 
	WHERE TIMESTAMP(SUBSTRING(a.gcp_updated,1,19)) >= TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE())
); 

DELETE FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rehire_details` WHERE TRUE;
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rehire_details` (
	SELECT
	  S1.Emp_id,
	  S1.hire_date,
	  S1.termination_date,
	  `bidata-sharedus-production.Functions.convertStringToHashkey`(CONCAT(S1.Emp_id,S1.hire_date,S1.termination_date)) AS HASHDIFF,
	  'RNA_Employees' AS SRC_SYSTEM,
	  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS CRE_DATE
	FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.rehire_details` S1 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rehire_details` S3   ON S1.Emp_id = S3.Emp_id 
	WHERE `bidata-sharedus-production.Functions.convertStringToHashkey`(CONCAT(S1.Emp_id,S1.hire_date,S1.termination_date)) != S3.HASHDIFF 
	AND S3.SRC_SYSTEM = 'RNA_Employees' 
); 

INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rehire_details` (
		SELECT A.* FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rehire_details` A LEFT OUTER JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rehire_details` B ON  A.HASHDIFF = B.HASHDIFF  
		WHERE A.CRE_DATE >= TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE()) AND B.HASHDIFF IS NULL
);
END

BEGIN

--Nested materialized views for performant denormalized layer
--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system`;
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_source_system`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
    allow_non_incremental_definition = true) as
select 
rtx_lead_uid, 
array_agg(struct(lst.rtx_lead_sid, lst.src_system, lst.src_system_attr_id, lst.src_system_attr_id_value, lst.upstream_src_system, lst.upstream_src_system_attr_id, lst.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value, lst.src_system_cre_date, lst.cre_date,so.order as system_order) order by so.order desc) as lead_source_system
 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lst
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association` l on lst.rtx_lead_sid = l.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_system_order` so on lst.src_system = so.system
group by
rtx_lead_uid
;
--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_contact`;
-- Fills NULL values for contact details using the last non-NULL value
-- ordered by cre_date.
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_contact`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,
  -- Calculate the latest non-null value for each column across the lead's history.
  FIRST_VALUE(name IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    -- UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ensures we look across the whole partition
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS name,
  FIRST_VALUE(address IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS address,
  FIRST_VALUE(city IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS city,
  FIRST_VALUE(state IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS state,
  FIRST_VALUE(postal_code IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS postal_code,
  FIRST_VALUE(phone IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS phone,
  FIRST_VALUE(email IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
    PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
    ORDER BY cre_date DESC
    ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
  ) AS email
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_contact`
-- The QUALIFY clause keeps only one arbitrary row per rtx_lead_uid 
-- after the window functions have been calculated.
QUALIFY
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid ORDER BY cre_date DESC) = 1
;

--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes`;
-- Fills NULL values for lead attributes using the last non-NULL value
-- ordered by cre_date.
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_attributes`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true,
  refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
SELECT
rtx_lead_uid,

FIRST_VALUE(market_type IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
ORDER BY cre_date DESC
ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
) AS market_type,

FIRST_VALUE(lead_type IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
ORDER BY cre_date DESC
ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
) AS lead_type,

FIRST_VALUE(lead_source IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
ORDER BY cre_date DESC
ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
) AS lead_source,

FIRST_VALUE(primary_pest IGNORE NULLS) OVER (
PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid
ORDER BY cre_date DESC
ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
) AS primary_pest

FROM
bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_attributes

QUALIFY
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid ORDER BY cre_date DESC) = 1
;

--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_inspections`;

create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_inspections`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
    allow_non_incremental_definition = true) 
    as 
select 
rtx_lead_uid, 
array_agg(struct(activity_type,activity_date,eff_date) order by eff_date desc) as activities
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_inspections`
group by rtx_lead_uid 
;

--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`;

create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_field_assignment`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
SELECT
  t1.rtx_lead_uid,
  ARRAY_AGG(
    STRUCT(
      t1.assignment_type,
      t1.assignment_value,eff_date
    )
    ORDER BY
      t1.assignment_type -- Optional: Order the final array by assignment_type
  ) AS fields
FROM (
  SELECT
    rtx_lead_uid,
    assignment_type,
    case when assignment_value = '1074' then '1234' else assignment_value end as assignment_value,
    eff_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY rtx_lead_uid, assignment_type
      ORDER BY eff_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_field_assignment`
) AS t1
WHERE
  t1.rn = 1 
GROUP BY
  t1.rtx_lead_uid
;


--drop materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`;
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_proposals`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
select 
rtx_lead_uid, 
array_agg(struct(quantity,service_amount,eff_date) order by eff_date desc) as proposals
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_proposals`
GROUP BY
  rtx_lead_uid
;

create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_sales`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
select 
rtx_lead_uid, 
array_agg(struct(quantity,total_amount,job_amount,contract_amount,product_amount,eff_date) order by cre_date desc) as sales
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_sales`
group by
rtx_lead_uid
;

-- Fills NULL values for lead status using the last non-NULL value
-- ordered by eff_date.
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_status`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
select 
rtx_lead_uid,  
array_agg(struct(status,eff_date) order by eff_date desc) as status
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_status`
group by rtx_lead_uid
;
-- Fills NULL values for stage and stage_order using the last non-NULL value
-- ordered by cre_date.
create or replace materialized view `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.vw_rtx_lead_stage`
OPTIONS (
  enable_refresh = true, refresh_interval_minutes = 1440,
  max_staleness = INTERVAL "1" DAY,
  allow_non_incremental_definition = true
) as
select 
rtx_lead_uid, 
array_agg(struct(s.stage,date_trunc(eff_date,day) as eff_date,date_trunc(cre_date,day)as cre_date,stage_order) order by stage_order desc,date_trunc(cre_date,day) desc ) as stage
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage` s 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_stage_order` so on upper(s.stage) = upper(so.stage)
group by rtx_lead_uid;
  


EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_rebuild_S3_materialized_views stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

--  ===================================================================== 

-- File        : leads/procedure/leads_s4_snapshot.sql
-- Author      : Savannah Overheim  (savannah.overheim@rentokil-terminix.com)
-- Created On  : 2025-12-02
-- Purpose     : Proc to snapshot RTX Leads model S4 view into physical table to lockdown lead counts. 2 different snapshot types: 
--                  1. Monthly_4thWorkday requested by Lindsey Bishop /*BI-7861 change to run on the day after the fourth workday SCO*/
--                  2. Daily_10thDay requested by Shiv Bhandari 
-- Associated Dataset/Project : Procedures/bidata-sharedus-production
-- Deployment Target          : BQ Procedure: `bidata-sharedus-production.Procedures.leads_s4_snapshot`

-- ======================================================================

Insert Into 
`bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Snp`
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid, lead_ID, business, received_date, source_system, market_type, lead_type, lead_source, lead_channel_1, lead_channel_2,  primary_pest, primary_pest_report_group, primary_pest_type_1, primary_pest_solution, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, contact_address, contact_city, contact_state, contact_zip_code, brand, originating_branch, assigned_branch, report_branch, assigned_employee_id, cancel_reason, sales_employee, sales_employee_id, created_by_employee_id, sales_employee_branch, sales_employee_job_role, created_by_employee_branch, created_by_employee_job_role, scheduled_date, inspected_date, proposed_date, services_proposed, value_proposed, sold_date, services_sold, value_sold_raw, sold_job_amount, sold_contract_amount, sold_product_amount, value_sold_started, started_contract_count, lead_status, cancel_date, closed_lost_date, closed_won_date, contacts_stage_count, MQL_stage_count, SQL_stage_count, scheduled_stage_count, inspected_stage_count, proposed_stage_count, sold_stage_count, contacts_stage_date, MQL_stage_date, SQL_stage_date, scheduled_stage_date, inspected_stage_date, proposed_stage_date, sold_stage_date, canceled_count, closed_lost_count, closed_won_count ,
  'Monthly_4thWorkday' as snapshot_type,
  date(DATE_TRUNC(received_date,month)) AS snapshot_yearmonth,
  current_timestamp() as snapshot_timestamp,
  --t.fourth_workday,
  --date_diff(t.fourth_workday,date(received_date),day)
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Vw` l
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
    firstofmonth,
   /*BI-7861 change to run on the day after the fourth workday SCO*/
    min(`date`) as run_date,
    AC_MonthYear_prev
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_RTX_Time`
  WHERE
    AC_NUMWORKED = 5
    AND AC_MonthYear_prev IS NOT NULL
    group by firstofmonth,  AC_MonthYear_prev )t
ON
  DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(DATE(l.received_date),month), interval 1 month) = t.firstofmonth 
where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Snp` s where l.rtx_lead_uid = s.rtx_lead_uid and snapshot_type ='Monthly_4thWorkday') and
current_date >= t.run_date and DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(DATE(l.received_date),month), interval 1 month) = date_trunc(current_date,month)
;



Insert Into 
`bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Snp`
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid, lead_ID, business, received_date, source_system, market_type, lead_type, lead_source, lead_channel_1, lead_channel_2,  primary_pest, primary_pest_report_group, primary_pest_type_1, primary_pest_solution, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, contact_address, contact_city, contact_state, contact_zip_code, brand, originating_branch, assigned_branch, report_branch, assigned_employee_id, cancel_reason, sales_employee, sales_employee_id, created_by_employee_id, sales_employee_branch, sales_employee_job_role, created_by_employee_branch, created_by_employee_job_role, scheduled_date, inspected_date, proposed_date, services_proposed, value_proposed, sold_date, services_sold, value_sold_raw, sold_job_amount, sold_contract_amount, sold_product_amount, value_sold_started, started_contract_count, lead_status, cancel_date, closed_lost_date, closed_won_date, contacts_stage_count, MQL_stage_count, SQL_stage_count, scheduled_stage_count, inspected_stage_count, proposed_stage_count, sold_stage_count, contacts_stage_date, MQL_stage_date, SQL_stage_date, scheduled_stage_date, inspected_stage_date, proposed_stage_date, sold_stage_date, canceled_count, closed_lost_count, closed_won_count ,
  'Daily_10thDay' as snapshot_type,
  date(DATE_TRUNC(received_date,month)) AS snapshot_yearmonth,
  current_timestamp() as snapshot_timestamp,
  --t.fourth_workday,
  --date_diff(t.fourth_workday,date(received_date),day)
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Vw` l
  INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    firstofmonth,
    `date` as fourth_workday,
    AC_MonthYear_prev
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Dim_RTX_Time`
  WHERE
    AC_Month_day_label = '4th Workday'
    AND AC_MonthYear_prev IS NOT NULL )t
ON
  DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(DATE(l.received_date),month), interval 1 month) = t.firstofmonth 
where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S4.Fact_Leads_Acc_Daily_Dtls_Snp` s where l.rtx_lead_uid = s.rtx_lead_uid and snapshot_type ='Daily_10thDay' ) and
(date_diff(current_date(),date(date_trunc(received_date,day)),day) >=10  or (date_diff(t.fourth_workday,date(received_date),day)between 0 and 10 and current_date >= t.fourth_workday));


EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_s4_snapshot stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  SELECT
      'TDW' AS src_system,
      'ACTID' as src_system_attr_id,
      cast (l.ACTID as string) AS src_system_attr_id_value,
      'N/A' AS upstream_src_system,
      'N/A' as upstream_src_system_attr_id,
      'N/A' AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
      l.received_date as src_system_cre_date,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l 
    where l.curr_ind = 'Y' 
  UNION ALL 
  select 
  u.src_system,
  m.src_system_attr_id,
  u.src_system_attr_id_value,
  u.upstream_src_system,
  m.upstream_src_system_attr_id ,
  u.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  u.src_system_cre_date,
  u.cre_date, 
    from (SELECT
      'LPP' AS src_system, 
      pp.ProspectNumber AS src_system_attr_id_value,
      CASE WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='CCM Prospects' THEN 'CCM' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='WF Prospects' THEN 'WF'
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='TRUSTED_ADVISOR' THEN 'TA'
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Sales Lead' THEN 'SL' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Inside Sales' THEN 'IS' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Unknown' THEN 'N/A' 
      else WF_CCM_Switch
      END AS upstream_src_system, -- 
      pp.ProspectNumber AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
      pp.ProspectDate as src_system_cre_date,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp 
	) u
      left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on u.src_system = m.src_system
      and u.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  left join  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association` destination_table
  ON
    (source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value
    OR
     source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value)
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
  WHERE
    destination_table.rtx_lead_uid IS NULL
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid),current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
/*TDW*/
SELECT 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(lp.last_name,''),', ',IFNULL(lp.first_Name,'')),
IFNULL(lp.address_1,''),
IFNULL(lp.city,''),
IFNULL(lp.state_code,''),
IFNULL(lp.postal_code,''),
IFNULL(coalesce(lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone),''),
IFNULL(coalesce(lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3),'')
)) as hashdiff,
concat(lp.last_name,', ',lp.first_Name) as name,
lp.address_1 as address,
lp.city as city,
lp.state_code as state,
lp.postal_code as postal_code,
coalesce(lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone) as phone,
coalesce(lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3) as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date 
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on lead.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID

where --lead.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 

union all 
/*LPP*/
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(pp.Name,''),
  IFNULL(pp.AddressLine1,''),
  IFNULL(pp.AddressLine4,''),
  IFNULL(pp.AddressLine5,''),
  IFNULL(pp.Postcode,''),
  IFNULL(pp.CustContactNumber,''),
  IFNULL(pp.ContactEmail,'')  
  )) as hashdiff,
  pp.Name as name,
  pp.AddressLine1 as address,
  pp.AddressLine4 as city,
  pp.AddressLine5 as state,
  pp.Postcode as postal_code,
  pp.CustContactNumber as phone,
  pp.ContactEmail as email,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  --Where extract(YEAR from ProspectDate) >= 2024
);

--rtx_lead_proposals
insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (
select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(min(laf.activity_date) as timestamp),
IFNULL(sl.service_line_code,''),
sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity), 
sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount))) as hashdiff,
cast(min(laf.activity_date) as timestamp) as eff_date,
sl.service_line_code,
sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity) as quantity, 
sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount) as service_value,
current_timestamp() as cre_date
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf --use laf.udt_date for incremental
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea2 on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea2.TMX_lead_activity_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l on laf.TMX_lead_SID = l.TMX_lead_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(l.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on l.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on laf.proposal_service_line_sid = sl.tmx_sa_item_service_line_sid
where lea2.lead_status_code IN ('PRP','PRH') 
and laf.activity_date >=  cast(date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
--and l.received_date >= '2024-01-01'
and l.curr_ind = 'Y' 
group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, sl.service_line_code 

union all

SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
  pp.FirstQuoteDate,
  pp.USLobProposal,
  cast(pp.EstimatedValue as numeric))) as hashdiff,
  pp.FirstQuoteDate as eff_date, 
  null as service_line_code,
  pp.USLobProposal as quantity,
  cast(pp.EstimatedValue as numeric) as service_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid        
where pp.FirstQuoteDate is not null
);



--rtx_lead_inspections
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` (
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,max(date_trunc(leaf.udt_date,day)),
	'Scheduled',min(lead.scheduled_date))) as hashdiff,
    cast(max(date_trunc(leaf.udt_date,day)) as timestamp) as eff_date, 
    'Scheduled' as activity_type,
    min(lead.scheduled_date) as activity_date,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID  
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` leaf on lead.TMX_lead_SID = leaf.TMX_lead_SID
  where
      lea.lead_status_code IN ('SCH','SCI')
      --and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
  group by 
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
union all
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.CreatedDate,'Scheduled',
  CAST(SUBSTR(pp.PlannedVisitdate,0, 10) AS timestamp))) as hashdiff,
  pp.CreatedDate as eff_date, --once we start capturing LPP source table we can check for first date plannedvisitdate is not null
  'Scheduled' as activity_type,
  CAST(SUBSTR(pp.PlannedVisitdate,0, 10) AS timestamp) as activity_date, 
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where PlannedVisitdate is not null

union all
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp),
	'Inspected',
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp))) as hashdiff,
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp) as eff_date, 
    'Inspected' as activity_type,
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp) as activity_date,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  where
  curr_inspected_date is not null
  --and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
  group by 
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

union all
	SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.FirstVisitDate,'Inspected',pp.FirstVisitDate)) as hashdiff,
  pp.FirstVisitDate as eff_date, 
  'Inspected' as activity_type,
  pp.FirstVisitDate as activity_date,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.FirstVisitDate is not null

);


--rtx_lead_sales
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` (
select 
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
      Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,min(accounting_date),sum(i.rawsale_amt))) as hashdiff,
			min(accounting_date) as eff_date,
			--i.sales_agreement_number,
			sum(case when sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC') then 1 else 0 end )as quantity,
			sum(i.rawsale_amt) as total_amount,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('SPC') and sl.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0  end )as job_amount ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('INI','REG','BIT') and sl.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH')  then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end )as contract_amount,
			sum(case when sl.service_line_code in ('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end) as product_amount ,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` sat ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = sat.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
			inner Join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
			inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(l2.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
			left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_customer` c on i.tmx_customer_sid = c.tmx_customer_sid
			where
			((sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','REG','BIT') AND sl.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) OR (sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','BIT'/*,'RNL' excluding renewals 12-11-2023 per Rob Fuller*/) AND sl.service_line1_short = 'TC'))
			and i.curr_ind='Y' 
			and i.rawsale_amt > 0
			and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
					inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on LAF.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
					group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid--l2.actid--, i.sales_agreement_number
union all 
  /*LPP*/
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	  pp.WonDate,pp.USLobProposalsSold,
	PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(pp.USLobProposalSoldValue as STRING)),
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(JobValue as STRING)),
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(ContractValue as STRING)),
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(ProductValue as STRING))
	)) as hashdiff,
    pp.WonDate as eff_date, 
    pp.USLobProposalsSold as quantity,
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(pp.USLobProposalSoldValue as STRING)) as total_amount,
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(JobValue as STRING)) as job_amount,
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(ContractValue as STRING))	AS	contract_amount,
    PARSE_NUMERIC(cast(ProductValue as STRING))	AS	product_amount,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
	from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  
	where pp.WonDate is not null

);


--rtx_lead_sale_link

--TDW
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sale_link` (
select 
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
      Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'TDW','sales_agreement_number',i.sales_agreement_number)) as hashdiff,
			'TDW' as sale_system,
			'sales_agreement_number' as sale_system_attr_id,
			cast(i.sales_agreement_number as string) as sale_system_attr_id_value,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` sat ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = sat.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
			inner Join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
      inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(l2.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
			left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_customer` c on i.tmx_customer_sid = c.tmx_customer_sid
			where
			((sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','REG','BIT') AND sl.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) OR (sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','BIT'/*,'RNL' excluding renewals 12-11-2023 per Rob Fuller*/) AND sl.service_line1_short = 'TC'))
			and i.curr_ind='Y' 
			and i.rawsale_amt > 0
			and b.BU_type in ('Branch','Satellite Branch')
			and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
					inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on LAF.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
					group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, i.sales_agreement_number
);

--rtx_lead_attributes
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(lp.market_type,''),IFNULL(la.lead_type_code,''),
      IFNULL(oBu.curr_division_code,''),IFNULL(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,''),
      IFNULL(k8425.OPS_bunit,''),IFNULL(la.lead_source_code,''),IFNULL(la.item_code,''))) as hashdiff,
 case  when lp.market_type = 'RES' then 'Residential'
        when lp.market_type = 'COM' then 'Commercial'
        else lp.market_type end as market_type,
  la.lead_type_code AS `lead_type`,
  CASE
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1996' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1992' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1998' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1901' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1074' THEN 'Lead Forms'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8601' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN k8425.OPS_bunit = '8425' THEN 'Field – CSC PIG'
    WHEN la.lead_source_code = 'PIG' THEN 'Field-PIG' 
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8441' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN LEFT(oBu.curr_division_code,1) = '8' THEN 'Calls'
  ELSE
  'Field'
END
  AS `lead_source`,
  la.item_code AS `primary_pest`,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date,
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` obu on lead.originating_BUnit_SID = obu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on lead.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID
  left join (
					SELECT
					 le.ACTID,
						OE.home_BUnit AS OPS_bunit
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on laf.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` le on laf.TMX_lead_SID = le.TMX_lead_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` oe on laf.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
				where
				lea.lead_status_code IN ('ASG','ASH','RQS','SCH','SCI')
				AND LA.lead_source_code = 'PIG' --- not service sale
				 and le.received_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
				 AND OE.home_BUnit = '8425'
				group by 
				le.ACTID,
					OE.home_BUnit
			) as k8425 on lead.ACTID = k8425.ACTID
      where 
      --lead.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
      lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 

  union all
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(pp.Channel,''),
  IFNULL(pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc,''),
  IFNULL(pp.Lead_reason,''),
  IFNULL(pp.USPestKey,''))) as hashdiff,
  pp.Channel as market_type,
  case  when pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc = 'CreativeColdCall' then 'CTV'
        when pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc = 'Inbound Leads' then 'INB'
        when pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc = 'Technician Lead' then 'TA'
        else pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc
        end AS lead_type,
  pp.Lead_reason AS `lead_source`,
  pp.USPestKey AS `primary_pest`,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
);


--rtx_lead_field_assignment
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (

  SELECT

  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,rtx_leads.cre_date,'assigned_branch',IFNULL(abu.branch_code,''))) as hashdiff,

  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,
  'assigned_branch' as field,
  cast(pp.BranchNumber as string) as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid    
  --Where extract(YEAR from ProspectDate) >= 2024

  union all

  SELECT

  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,--'load_date' as eff_date, ( we need the timestamp when the record was staged)
  'originating_branch' as field,
  abu.branch_code as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y'

  union all

  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,rtx_leads.cre_date,'assigned_employee',e.employee_jde_number)) as hashdiff,
  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,--'load_date' as eff_date, ( we need the timestamp when the record was staged)
  'assigned_employee' as field,
  cast(e.employee_jde_number as string) as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` e on lead.curr_assigned_employee_sid = e.tmx_employee_sid
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 

  union all
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,current_timestamp(),'assigned_employee',IFNULL(pp.CreatedByEmployeeCode,''))) as hashdiff,
  current_timestamp() as eff_date, --placeholder
  'assigned_employee' as field,
  pp.employee_id_created_by as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid    
  --Where extract(YEAR from ProspectDate) >= 2024

  union all
  SELECT
   rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.cre_date,'sales_employee',se.employee_jde_number)) as hashdiff,
  track.cre_date as eff_date,--'load_date' as eff_date, ( we need the timestamp when the record was staged)
  'sales_employee' as field,
 cast(se.employee_jde_number as string) as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join (select 
			l2.ACTID, 
			max(TMX_sales_employee_SID) as TMX_sales_employee_SID
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
			inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
			where
			 i.curr_ind='Y'

					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
			group by l2.ACTID
			) csva on  lead.ACTID = csva.ACTID 
    left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` se on csva.tmx_sales_employee_sid = se.tmx_employee_sid
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 

union all
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,rtx_leads.cre_date,'sales_employee',IFNULL(pp.SalesEmployeeCode,''))) as hashdiff,
  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date, 
  'sales_employee' as field,
  pp.employee_id_actioner as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid    
 --Where extract(YEAR from ProspectDate) >= 2024

union all

SELECT

  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,rtx_leads.cre_date,'cancel_reason',
  IFNULL(trim(la.cancel_reason_description),''))) as hashdiff,

  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes`  la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID

	where

    and lead.curr_ind = 'Y'
    group by 
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,rtx_leads.cre_date,la.cancel_reason_description

union all

  Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.LostRejectDate,'cancel_reason',IFNULL(pp.prospect_rejection_reason,''))) as hashdiff,

  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
