--rtx_lead_status
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
 	 /*TDW & LPP Open*/ 
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
   
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */
  /*TDW Cancelled*/
  union all
  SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,coalesce(min(lead.cancel_date),min(lead.cre_date)),'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
		coalesce(min(lead.cancel_date),min(lead.cre_date)) as eff_date, 
    'Cancelled' as status,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
	from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes`  la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
		left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID and lea.lead_status_code IN ('CNL')
 	where
		trim(la.cancel_reason_description) != '' 
  	--and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
	group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

  /*LPP Cancelled*/
  union all
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
      Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,CAST(pp.LostRejectDate AS DATE),'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
      pp.LostRejectDate as eff_date, 
      'Cancelled' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    where pp.LostRejectDate is not null

  /*TDW Open - UnCancelled */
  union all
  SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
      Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(min(lead.cre_date) as timestamp),'Open')) as hashdiff,
      cast(min(lead.cre_date) as timestamp) as eff_date, -- date lead entered stage,only covering first entry 
     'Open' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
  	from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes`  la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
		left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID 
    where lea.lead_status_code IN ('UCN')
      --and l.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
    group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

  /* Closed Won */
  /*TDW Closed Won */
  union all
  SELECT
		rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(min(lead.sold_date) as timestamp),'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
		cast(min(lead.sold_date) as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	where lead.sold_date is not null
	--and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
	group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

  /* LPP Closed Won */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.WonDate,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    pp.WonDate as eff_date, 
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.WonDate is not null

  /*TDW Closed Lost*/
  union all
  select 
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
       Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
      case  when la.market_type = 'RES' and date_diff(current_timestamp(),s.eff_date,day) > 30 then current_timestamp 
            when la.market_type <> 'RES' and date_diff(current_timestamp(),s.eff_date,day) > 180 then current_timestamp 
            else null 
      end as eff_date,
      'Closed Lost' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` la on la.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s on s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and stage = 'Proposed'
   where not exists ( select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and stage = 'Sold' )

  /* LPP Closed Lost */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.dlClosedDate,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    pp.dlClosedDate as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.dlClosedDate is not null and pp.WonDate is null

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
    SELECT
        'LE' AS src_system, 
        'LELeadUID' as src_system_attr_id,
        le.UID AS src_system_attr_id_value,
        'N/A'  AS upstream_src_system, 
        'N/A' as upstream_src_system_attr_id, 
        'N/A' AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
        cast(le.DateAdded_date as timestamp) as src_system_cre_date,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract` le
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
  --WHERE --Stage everything to capture changes SCO 1/23/2025
    --destination_table.rtx_lead_uid IS NULL
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete contact info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid */
--SCO LE addition 8/29/2024 
select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(le.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(le.FirstName,'')),
IFNULL(le.Address,''),
IFNULL(le.City,''),
IFNULL(le.State,''),
IFNULL(le.ZipCode,''),
IFNULL(le.Phone,''),
IFNULL(le.Email,'')
)) as hashdiff,  
concat(IFNULL(le.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(le.FirstName,'')) as name,
Address as address,
City as city,
State as state,
ZipCode as postal_code,
Phone as phone, 
Email as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date,
		null AS company,
    null AS country 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract`  le 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (le.UID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  --more recent info takes precedence - don't bring in contact info if we already have it from downstream systems
  where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` lc where lc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid)
);

--rtx_lead_proposals
--log of proposals made,
--not available for SE




--rtx_lead_inspections 
--log of two activity types, an inspection being scheduled, and and inpsection being inspected ie completed
-- no addition will be available for SE or LE SCO 08/27/2024

--rtx_lead_sales
--sum of all raw sales made from the lead
--SCO LE no addition will be available

--rtx_lead_attributes
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid*/
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
--SCO LE addition 8/29/2024

  select
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, -- this will be rtx_lead_uid
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(CustomerType,''),
    IFNULL(ReasonforContact,''))) as hashdiff,
  case CustomerType 
        when  'Residential' then 'RES'
        when 'Business' then 'COM' 
        else CustomerType
    end as market_type, --has one bad record with value 'jaRoy' from October 2023
  'INB' as lead_type, 
  'Web Form' as lead_source,
  ReasonforContact as primary_pest,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date 
 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract`  le 
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (le.UID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
 
);


--rtx_lead_field_assignment
--log of relevant fields that we need to track changes to
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (
 
/*assigned_branch*/
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'assigned_branch',IFNULL(le.DistrictNumber,''))) as hashdiff,
  cast(le.DateVerified_date as timestamp)  as eff_date, --for incremental le.LastReturnActionDate_date
  'assigned_branch' as field,
  le.DistrictNumber as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract` le
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on le.UID = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid    
where le.DistrictNumber is not null

  union all

/*Cancel Reason*/
--SCO LE addition 8/29/2024
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'cancel_reason',IFNULL(le.VerifyResponse,''))) as hashdiff,
  cast(le.DateVerified_date as timestamp)  as eff_date,
  'cancel_reason' as field,
  le.VerifyResponse as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract` le
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on le.UID = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid    
where lower(le.VerifyResponse) is not null

union all 
--le new or existing
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'new_or_existing_customer',IFNULL(le.NewOrExistingCustomer,''))) as hashdiff,
  cast(le.DateAdded_date as timestamp)  as eff_date,
  'new_or_existing_customer' as field,
  le.NewOrExistingCustomer as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract` le 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on le.UID = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  
  where le.NewOrExistingCustomer is not null

union all
--le brand
SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'brand',IFNULL(le.LeadSource,''))) as hashdiff,
  cast(le.DateAdded_date as timestamp)  as eff_date,
  'brand' as field,
  le.LeadSource as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract` le 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on le.UID = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  
  where le.LeadSource is not null

);

--rtx_lead_sale_link
--log of sales agreement numbers/contract ids/setupids/orderids to connect to sales model for more detail
--not available for LE
 
--rtx_lead_stage
--log of lead entering funnel stages
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
  /* 1. Contacts (Raw Leads) */ 
	SELECT
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp),'Contacts')) as hashdiff,
			cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
			'Contacts' AS stage,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
	FROM
			`bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Contacts' ) 
  and src_system in ('LE')

union all

    /* 2. Marketing Qualified Lead */
  SELECT
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp),'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
			cast(src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
			'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' AS stage,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
		FROM 
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
			where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
      and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` f where rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = f.rtx_lead_uid and f.assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' and lower(f.assignment_value)  like '%duplicate%' )  
) 
-- LE does not reach other funnel stages
;

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

--LE needs some logic for lost/expired leads?


);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
--LPP only
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  select 
  u.src_system,
  m.src_system_attr_id,
  u.src_system_attr_id_value,
  u.upstream_src_system,
  m.upstream_src_system_attr_id ,
  u.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  u.src_system_cre_date,
  u.cre_date, 
    from (SELECT
      'LPP' AS src_system, 
      pp.ProspectNumber AS src_system_attr_id_value,
      CASE WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='CCM Prospects' THEN 'CCM' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='WF Prospects' THEN 'WF'
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='TRUSTED_ADVISOR' THEN 'TA'
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Sales Lead' THEN 'SL' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Inside Sales' THEN 'IS' 
      WHEN WF_CCM_Switch ='Unknown' THEN 'N/A' 
      else WF_CCM_Switch
      END AS upstream_src_system, -- 
      pp.ProspectNumber AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
      pp.ProspectDate as src_system_cre_date,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp 
	) u
      left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on u.src_system = m.src_system
      and u.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;

        when pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc = 'Inbound Leads' then 'INB'

        else pp.BusinessoriginSystemDesc
        end AS lead_type,
  case when upper(pp.Lead_reason) in ('ISR CREATIVE', 'CURRENT CUSTOMER') then concat(pp.Lead_reason,'-',ne.new_existing) else  pp.Lead_reason end AS `lead_source`,

            from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track
            inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
            inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
            inner join ( SELECT fa.rtx_lead_uid, orderNum, SellDate  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_rpp_stage2_Contract` ppc
             inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on cast(ppc.locationID as string) = fa.assignment_value and fa.assignment_type = 'pp_location_id') pps on pps.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
              where not exists( select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sale_link` rsl where rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = rsl.rtx_lead_uid and cast(pps.orderNum as string)= rsl.sale_system_attr_id_value) and track.src_system_cre_date <= cast(pps.SellDate as timestamp)
);

--rtx_lead_stage
--log of lead entering funnel stages
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
  /* 1. Contacts (Raw Leads) Not available from LPP contact will be backfilled later in procedure */ 

    /* 2. Marketing Qualified Lead Business process says LPP starts at SQL, but there are occassional records with null BranchNumber, and if they ever start to used a "duplicate" cancel reason we want to be able to remove them */ 
  SELECT
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp),'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
			cast(src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
			'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' AS stage,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
		FROM 
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
			where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
      and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` f where rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = f.rtx_lead_uid and f.assignment_type = 'cancel_reason' and lower(f.assignment_value)  like '%duplicate%' ) 
          ) 
;
-- separate statement because following stages must refer to MQL for qualifying conditions

INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
  /* 3. Sales Qualified Lead */ 
		SELECT
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Sales_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
			cast(fa.eff_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
			'Sales_Qualified_Lead' AS stage,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
		FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid and fa.assignment_type = 'assigned_branch'
 left join (select rtx_lead_uid,min(eff_date) as eff_date 
								from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` 
								where activity_type = 'Inspected' 
								group by rtx_lead_uid) i on rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid
			where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
			and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fc where rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fc.rtx_lead_uid and fc.assignment_value in ('Bad data') /*and fc.eff_date <= i.eff_date */) 
			and  exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa where rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid and fa.assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' )  
);

--separate statement because following stages must refer to SQL for qualifying conditions
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
  SELECT
    i.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(i.rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date, 
    activity_type as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` i
	where activity_type = 'Scheduled' 
	and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = i.activity_type and s.eff_date = i.eff_date )	and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all 

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Scheduled'
    where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Scheduled' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
    
  
union all 
SELECT
        i.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(i.rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
        eff_date, 
        activity_type as stage,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` i
        where activity_type = 'Inspected' 
        and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = i.activity_type and s.eff_date = i.eff_date )
						and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
SELECT
		p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
		eff_date, 
		'Proposed' as stage,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
		from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` p
	where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = p.eff_date )
				and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
        qualify row_number() over ( partition by p.rtx_lead_uid order by eff_date desc) = 1

union all

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Proposed' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Proposed'
    where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
 SELECT
					 p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Sold')) as hashdiff,
					 eff_date,
           'Sold' as stage,
						current_timestamp() as cre_date
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` p
					where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Sold' and s.eff_date = s.eff_date )	
					and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

);

--separate statements to "backfill/ infer funnel stages eg. we have record something sold, but no record of the proposal, but obviously it must have been proposed so we infer it"

--we need inference for prior stages for all source systems
--1. infer if sold, must have been proposed, inspected, and scheduled
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 

    union all

  select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Inspected' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Inspected') 
    
    union all

  select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Proposed' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold' 
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Proposed') 
);


-- 2. infer if proposed, must have been inspected & scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Proposed'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 

    union all

    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Inspected' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Proposed'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Inspected') 
);

-- 3. infer if inspected, must have been scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Inspected'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 
)
;
-- 3. infer if SQL, must have been MQL & Contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
)
;
-- 3. infer if MQL, must have been Contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Contacts')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Contacts' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Contacts') 
)
;

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */
  /*LPP Cancelled*/
  union all
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,CAST(pp.LostRejectDate AS DATE),'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
      pp.LostRejectDate as eff_date, 
      'Cancelled' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    where pp.LostRejectDate is not null

  
  /* Closed Won */
  /* LPP Closed Won */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.WonDate,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    pp.WonDate as eff_date, 
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.WonDate is not null

  /* LPP Closed Lost */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.dlClosedDate,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    pp.dlClosedDate as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.dlClosedDate is not null and pp.WonDate is null

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  SELECT
        'PNS' AS src_system, 
        'PNSLeadUID' as src_system_attr_id,
        cast(pns.LeadUID as string) AS src_system_attr_id_value,
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN 'SE' 
        else  'N/A' 
        END AS upstream_src_system,  
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN 'SELeadUID' 
        else 'N/A' 
        end as upstream_src_system_attr_id,
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN cast(pns.SELeadUID  as string)
        else 'N/A' end  AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
        cast(pns.DateAdded as timestamp) as src_system_cre_date,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        FROM `bidata-sharedus-dev.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS` pns
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
  --WHERE --Stage everything to capture changes SCO 1/23/2025
    --destination_table.rtx_lead_uid IS NULL
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(pns.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(pns.FirstName,'')),
IFNULL(pns.Address,''),
IFNULL(pns.City,''),
IFNULL(pns.State,''),
IFNULL(cast(pns.ZipCode as string),''),
IFNULL(pns.PhoneNumber,''),
IFNULL(pns.Email,'')
)) as hashdiff,  
concat(IFNULL(pns.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(pns.FirstName,'')) as name,
Address as address,
City as city,
State as state,
cast(pns.ZipCode as string) as postal_code,
PhoneNumber as phone, 
Email as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-dev.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS` pns 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  --more recent info takes precedence - don't bring in contact info if we already have it from downstream systems
  where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` lc where lc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid)
);

    'Sales_Qualified_Lead' AS stage,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS cre_date
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track
  INNER JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc
  ON
    track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  INNER JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads
  ON
    assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  /*LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa
  ON
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = fa.rtx_lead_uid
    AND fa.assignment_type = 'assigned_branch' --SE will NOT reach SQL UNTIL wee have district added TO assigned branch*/
  WHERE
	  src_system IN ('PNS')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s WHERE s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid AND s.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fc WHERE rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = fc.rtx_lead_uid AND fc.assignment_value IN ('Bad Sourcing') )
    AND  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s WHERE s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid AND stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')
    AND ((( NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` f INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map
          ON CONCAT('SE|',UPPER(f.assignment_value)) = UPPER(map.Key) AND map.Lead_Stage IN('Contact', 'Cancelled','MQL')
          WHERE rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = f.rtx_lead_uid AND f.assignment_type = 'system_status')
         /* OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa WHERE rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = fa.rtx_lead_uid
            AND fa.assignment_type = 'assigned_branch'  )*/ ) )) );

--separate statement because following stages must refer to SQL for qualifying conditions
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
  -- SE scheduled -- there is no record in actual inspections table because no dates are available to capture, we are using status 

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Scheduled'
    where 
    track.src_system IN ('PNS') and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Scheduled' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
    
  
union all 
SELECT
        i.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(i.rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
        eff_date, 
        activity_type as stage,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` i
        where activity_type = 'Inspected' 
        and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = i.activity_type and s.eff_date = i.eff_date )
						and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
SELECT
		p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
		eff_date, 
		'Proposed' as stage,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
		from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` p
	where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = p.eff_date )
				and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
        qualify row_number() over ( partition by p.rtx_lead_uid order by eff_date desc) = 1

union all -- SE proposed -- there is no record in actual proposals table because no dates/values are available to capture, we are using status 

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Proposed' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Proposed'
    where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
 SELECT
					 p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Sold')) as hashdiff,
					 eff_date,
           'Sold' as stage,
						current_timestamp() as cre_date
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` p
					where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Sold' and s.eff_date = s.eff_date )	
					and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
-- separate SE sold stage query not necessary bc recorded in actual rtx_lead_sales
);

--separate statements to "backfill/ infer funnel stages eg. we have record something sold, but no record of the proposal, but obviously it must have been proposed so we infer it"

--we need inference for prior stages for all source systems
--1. infer if sold, must have been proposed, inspected, and scheduled
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 

    union all

  select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Inspected' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Inspected') 
    
    union all

  select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Proposed' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sold' 
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Proposed') 
);


-- 2. infer if proposed, must have been inspected & scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Proposed'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 

    union all

    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Inspected' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Proposed'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Inspected') 
);

-- 3. infer if inspected, must have been scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Inspected'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 
)
;
-- 3. infer if SQL, must have been MQL & Contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
)
;
-- 3. infer if MQL, must have been Contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Contacts')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Contacts' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Contacts') 
)
;

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */

    /*SE Cancelled*/ --SCO SE addition 8/29/2024
union all

    SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
    pns.LastUpdate  as eff_date,
    'Cancelled' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-dev.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Cancelled'

  /* Closed Won */
union all 
   /*SE Closed Won*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    pns.LastUpdate  as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-dev.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Sold'

   union all
      /*SE Closed Lost*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    pns.LastUpdate  as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-dev.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string)  = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Lost'

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  SELECT
        'PNS' AS src_system, 
        'PNSLeadUID' as src_system_attr_id,
        cast(pns.LeadUID as string) AS src_system_attr_id_value,
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN 'SE' 
        else  'N/A' 
        END AS upstream_src_system,  
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN 'SELeadUID' 
        else 'N/A' 
        end as upstream_src_system_attr_id,
        CASE WHEN pns.SELeadUID is not null THEN cast(pns.SELeadUID  as string)
        else 'N/A' end  AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
        cast(pns.DateAdded as timestamp) as src_system_cre_date,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        FROM  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS_RN` pns
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
  --WHERE --Stage everything to capture changes SCO 1/23/2025
    --destination_table.rtx_lead_uid IS NULL
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(pns.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(pns.FirstName,'')),
IFNULL(pns.Address,''),
IFNULL(pns.City,''),
IFNULL(pns.State,''),
IFNULL(cast(pns.ZipCode as string),''),
IFNULL(pns.PhoneNumber,''),
IFNULL(pns.Email,'')
)) as hashdiff,  
concat(IFNULL(pns.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(pns.FirstName,'')) as name,
Address as address,
City as city,
State as state,
cast(pns.ZipCode as string) as postal_code,
PhoneNumber as phone, 
Email as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date,
CompanyName as company,
Country as country
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS_RN` pns 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  --more recent info takes precedence - don't bring in contact info if we already have it from downstream systems
  where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` lc where lc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid)
);


--rtx_lead_proposals
--log of proposals made, TDW has service line granularity


insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (
SELECT

  -- SE scheduled -- there is no record in actual inspections table because no dates are available to capture, we are using status 

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Scheduled'
    where 
    track.src_system IN ('PNS') and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Scheduled' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
    
  
union all 
SELECT
        i.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(i.rtx_lead_uid,'Inspected')) as hashdiff,
        eff_date, 
        activity_type as stage,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` i
        where activity_type = 'Inspected' 
        and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = i.activity_type and s.eff_date = i.eff_date )
						and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
SELECT
		p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
		eff_date, 
		'Proposed' as stage,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
		from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` p
	where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = p.eff_date )
				and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
        qualify row_number() over ( partition by p.rtx_lead_uid order by eff_date desc) = 1

union all -- SE proposed -- there is no record in actual proposals table because no dates/values are available to capture, we are using status 

      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Proposed')) as hashdiff,
    fa.eff_date,
    'Proposed' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` fa on  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  = fa.rtx_lead_uid 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(fa.assignment_value)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Proposed'
    where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Proposed' and s.eff_date = fa.eff_date )	
    and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 

union all
 SELECT
					 p.rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(p.rtx_lead_uid,'Sold')) as hashdiff,
					 eff_date,
           'Sold' as stage,
						current_timestamp() as cre_date
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` p
					where not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid and s.stage = 'Sold' and s.eff_date = s.eff_date )	
					and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = p.rtx_lead_uid  and stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead') 
-- separate SE sold stage query not necessary bc recorded in actual rtx_lead_sales
);

--separate statements to "backfill/ infer funnel stages eg. we have record something sold, but no record of the proposal, but obviously it must have been proposed so we infer it"

--we need inference for prior stages for all source systems
--1. infer if sold, must have been proposed, inspected, and scheduled
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
select

-- 2. infer if proposed, must have been inspected & scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Scheduled' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i

    select
