-- 3. infer if inspected, must have been scheduled 
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Scheduled')) as hashdiff,

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select

    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
)
;
-- 3. infer if MQL, must have been Contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select

    'Contacts' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Contacts') 
)
;

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */

    /*SE Cancelled*/ --SCO SE addition 8/29/2024
union all

    SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
    cast(pns.LastUpdate as timestamp)  as eff_date,
    'Cancelled' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS_RN` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Cancelled'

  /* Closed Won */
union all 
   /*SE Closed Won*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    cast(pns.LastUpdate as timestamp)  as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS_RN` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Sold'

   union all
      /*SE Closed Lost*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    cast(pns.LastUpdate as timestamp)  as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract_PNS_RN` pns  
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(pns.LeadUID as string)  = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(pns.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Lost'

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental_PNS_v1 stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  SELECT
        'SE' AS src_system, 
        'SELeadUID' as src_system_attr_id,
        se.LeadUID AS src_system_attr_id_value,
        CASE WHEN se.LELeadUID is not null THEN 'LE' 
        else  'N/A' 
        END AS upstream_src_system,  
        CASE WHEN se.LELeadUID is not null THEN 'LELeadUID' 
        else 'N/A' 
        end as upstream_src_system_attr_id,
        CASE WHEN se.LELeadUID is not null THEN se.LELeadUID 
        else 'N/A' end  AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
        cast(se.DateAdded_date as timestamp) as src_system_cre_date,
        current_timestamp() as cre_date
        FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
  --WHERE --Stage everything to capture changes SCO 1/23/2025
    --destination_table.rtx_lead_uid IS NULL
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete contact info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid */
--SCO SE addition 8/27/2024 
select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(se.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(se.FirstName,'')),
IFNULL(se.Address,''),
IFNULL(se.City,''),
IFNULL(se.State,''),
IFNULL(se.ZipCode,''),
IFNULL(se.PhoneNumber,''),
IFNULL(se.Email,'')
)) as hashdiff,  
concat(IFNULL(se.LastName,''),', ',IFNULL(se.FirstName,'')) as name,
Address as address,
City as city,
State as state,
ZipCode as postal_code,
PhoneNumber as phone, 
Email as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date,
null AS company,
null AS country
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (se.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  --more recent info takes precedence - don't bring in contact info if we already have it from downstream systems
  where not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` lc where lc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid)
);


--rtx_lead_proposals
--log of proposals made, TDW has service line granularity


insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (
SELECT
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
ProposalValue)) as hashdiff,
						cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date, 
						null as service_line_code,
						1 as quantity, --no field available for this, set to 1 or leave null?
						safe_cast(ProposalValue as numeric) as service_value, --this field needs to be added to the API
							current_timestamp() as cre_date
						 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Stage ='Proposed'
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(se.LeadUID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
where ProposalValue is not null and safe_cast(ProposalValue as numeric) >0
)
;

--rtx_lead_inspections 
--log of two activity types, an inspection being scheduled, and and inpsection being inspected ie completed
-- no addition will be available for SE or LE SCO 08/27/2024

--rtx_lead_sales
--sum of all raw sales made from the lead
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` (
--SCO SE addition 8/27/2024
SELECT
						rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
           `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	  1,
	SoldServiceAmount
	)) as hashdiff,
  cast(coalesce(ClosedDate,LastUpdate_date) as timestamp) as eff_date,
						1 as quantity, -- not available, set to 1 or leave null
						parse_numeric(SoldServiceAmount)as total_amount,
						null as job_amount, 
						null	AS	contract_amount,
						null	AS	product_amount,

union all
 SELECT

					 eff_date,
           'Sold' as stage,

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */

    /*SE Cancelled*/ --SCO SE addition 8/29/2024
union all

    SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
    cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Cancelled' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Cancelled'

  /* Closed Won */
union all 
   /*SE Closed Won*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Sold'

   union all
      /*SE Closed Lost*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,

    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date

    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Lost'

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN
--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker`
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
	SELECT 
	COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,
		x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),
		x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''),
		x.src_system_cre_date)) as hashdiff,
    x.src_system,
	x.src_system_attr_id,
	x.src_system_attr_id_value,
	x.upstream_src_system,
	x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
	x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
	x.src_system_cre_date,
	x.cre_date
	from 
	(
		SELECT
		'SFRTX' AS src_system,
		'OpportunityObjectId' AS src_system_attr_id,
		opp.Id AS src_system_attr_id_value,
		case when lead.ConvertedOpportunityId is not null then 'SFRTXL' else 'N/A' end AS upstream_src_system,
		case when lead.ConvertedOpportunityId is not null then 'LeadObjectId' else 'N/A' end AS upstream_src_system_attr_id,
		case when lead.ConvertedOpportunityId is not null then lead.Id else 'N/A' end AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
		cast(opp.CreatedDate as timestamp) AS src_system_cre_date,
		current_timestamp() AS cre_date
	FROM
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp
	LEFT JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead
		ON opp.Id = lead.ConvertedOpportunityId
	--WHERE lead.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NULL
	) x
    left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,
		x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),
		x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''),
		x.src_system_cre_date)) = s3track.hashdiff 

);

--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association`
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
	WITH filtered_data AS (
		WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
		SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
		FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
	  )
	  SELECT
		source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
		`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
	  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
	  FROM
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
	  INNER JOIN  
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
		and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
	  LEFT JOIN
		deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
	  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
	  LEFT JOIN
		 deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
	  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
	)
	SELECT
	  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
	  current_timestamp() as cre_date
	FROM
	  filtered_data;
  

--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead`
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
	WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
	  SELECT
		source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
	  FROM
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
	  LEFT JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
	  ON
		source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
	)
	SELECT
	  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
	  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
	FROM
	  filtered_lead_data;

--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes`
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
	SELECT 
		rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid  AS rtx_lead_uid,
		`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(
		  opp.Id,
		  IFNULL(ry.name,''),
		  IFNULL(opp.Lead_Type__c,''),
		  IFNULL( opp.LeadSource,''),
		  IFNULL(opp.Primary_Product_Interest__c,''))) as hashdiff,
		ry.name                         AS market_type,
		opp.Lead_Type__c                AS lead_type,
		opp.LeadSource                  AS lead_source,
		opp.Primary_Product_Interest__c AS primary_pest,
		current_timestamp()                  AS cre_date
	FROM 
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp
	INNER JOIN 
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_RecordType_Daily` AS ry
		ON opp.RecordTypeId = ry.Id
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	/*LEFT JOIN 
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead
		ON opp.Id = lead.ConvertedOpportunityId*/
	--WHERE lead.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NULL

);


--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid              AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
          opp.CreatedDate,'creating_employee',emp.RTX_Employee_Number__c)) as hashdiff,
    CAST(opp.CreatedDate AS TIMESTAMP)  AS eff_date,
    'creating_employee'                 AS assignment_type,
    emp.RTX_Employee_Number__c          AS RTX_Employee_Number__c,
    current_timestamp()                      AS cre_date
FROM
   `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` opp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Employee__c_Daily` AS emp  on emp.User__c = opp.CreatedById
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid


UNION ALL
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid              AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
          opp.CreatedDate,'assigned_employee',emp.RTX_Employee_Number__c)) as hashdiff,
    CAST(opp.CreatedDate AS TIMESTAMP)  AS eff_date,
    'assigned_employee'                 AS assignment_type,
    emp.RTX_Employee_Number__c          AS RTX_Employee_Number__c,
    current_timestamp()                      AS cre_date
FROM
   `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` opp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Employee__c_Daily` AS emp  on emp.User__c = opp.OwnerId
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid


UNION ALL

SELECT
     rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid              AS rtx_lead_uid,
     `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
          opp.CreatedDate,'assigned_employee_designation',emp.Designation__c)) as hashdiff,
    CAST(opp.CreatedDate AS TIMESTAMP)  AS eff_date,
    'assigned_employee_designation'     AS assignment_type,
    emp.Designation__c                  AS Designation__c,
    current_timestamp()                      AS cre_date
FROM
   `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` opp
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Employee__c_Daily` AS emp on emp.User__c = opp.OwnerId
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

    

);
--rtx_lead_field_assignment (assigned_branch,sales_employee,new_or_existing_customer,cancel_reason)
--Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid AS rtx_lead_uid,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
				opp.CreatedDate,'assigned_branch',branch.BU_Code__c)) as hashdiff,
    opp.CreatedDate AS eff_date,
    'assigned_branch' AS assignment_type,

FROM

	insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (
	SELECT
	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid AS rtx_lead_uid,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	   IF(t.eff_date IS NULL,'', cast(t.eff_date as string)),
	   'Propose',qli.Product_Code__c,COALESCE(qli.Quantity, 0),
		(COALESCE(qli.Corrective_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) + 
		  COALESCE(qli.InitialMaint_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) +
		  COALESCE(qli.Merchandise_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) +
		  COALESCE(qli.Total_Annual_Cost__c, 0))   
	   )) as hashdiff,
	t.eff_date AS eff_date,
	qli.Product_Code__c AS service_line_code,
	CAST(COALESCE(qli.Quantity, 0) AS INTEGER) AS quantity,
	CAST(
	COALESCE(qli.Corrective_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) + 
	COALESCE(qli.InitialMaint_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) +
	COALESCE(qli.Merchandise_User_Edited_Net_Price__c, 0) +
	COALESCE(qli.Total_Annual_Cost__c, 0) as NUMERIC) AS service_amount,
	current_timestamp() AS cre_date
	FROM (
	SELECT
		opphis.OpportunityId AS rtx_lead_uid,
		opphis.CreatedDate AS eff_date,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY opphis.OpportunityId ORDER BY opphis.CreatedDate DESC) AS rn
	FROM
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_RTXSF_OpportunityHistory_Daily` AS opphis
	WHERE
		opphis.StageName = 'Propose'
	) t
	LEFT JOIN 
	`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` opp
	ON t.rtx_lead_uid = opp.Id    
	LEFT JOIN
	`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Quote_Daily` quo
	ON quo.OpportunityId = opp.Id
	LEFT JOIN
	`bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_RTXSF_QuoteLineItem_Daily` qli
	ON qli.QuoteId = quo.Id 
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	WHERE
	t.rn = 1
	AND opp.First_Presented_Date__c IS NOT NULL
	/*AND NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead
		WHERE lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = t.rtx_lead_uid
			AND lead.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NOT NULL)*/
	);

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
SELECT
	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid   AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,opphis.CreatedDate,
    CASE opphis.StageName
      WHEN 'New' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN 'Closed Lost' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      WHEN 'Closed Won' THEN 'Closed Won'
    END))  as hashdiff,
    opphis.CreatedDate                  AS eff_date, 
    CASE opphis.StageName
      WHEN 'New' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN 'Closed Lost' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      WHEN 'Closed Won' THEN 'Closed Won'
    END                                 AS status,
    current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date
FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_OpportunityHistory_Daily` AS opphis
LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` ld
    ON ld.ConvertedOpportunityId = opphis.OpportunityId
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opphis.OpportunityId = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
    --ld.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NULL         AND 
    opphis.StageName in ('New','Closed Won','Closed Lost')

union all

SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid         AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
         'Cancelled',opp.Loss_Reason__c)) as hashdiff,
      coalesce(cast(opp.Closed_Lost_Timestamp__c as timestamp),opp.CreatedDate)                     AS eff_date,
      'Cancelled'                     AS status,
      current_timestamp()                      AS cre_date
  FROM
     `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp
--LEFT JOIN
   -- `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead
   -- ON opp.Id = lead.ConvertedOpportunityId
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  WHERE
      --lead.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NULL AND 
      opp.Loss_Reason__c is not null
);

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sale_link` (
SELECT
	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid                 AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
        'SFRTX','quote_number',IFNULL(quo.QuoteNumber,''))) as hashdiff,
    'SFRTX' AS sale_system,
    'quote_number' AS sale_system_attr_id, --'quote_id' AS sale_system_attr_id,
    quo.QuoteNumber AS sale_system_attr_value,
    current_timestamp() AS cre_date
FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` opp
LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Quote_Daily` quo
    ON quo.OpportunityId = opp.Id
LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` ld
    ON ld.ConvertedOpportunityId = opp.Id
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on opp.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
WHERE
    opp.StageName = 'Closed Won'
    and
    opp.CloseDate is not null
   -- AND ld.ConvertedOpportunityId IS NULL
);


EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental_SFRTX_OPP stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN

  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
    SELECT 
    COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,
      x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),
      x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''),
      x.src_system_cre_date)) as hashdiff,
      x.src_system,
    x.src_system_attr_id,
    x.src_system_attr_id_value,
    x.upstream_src_system,
    x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
    x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
    x.src_system_cre_date,
    x.cre_date
    from 
    (

    SELECT
      'SFRTXL'                             AS src_system,
      'LeadObjectId'                      AS src_system_attr_id,
      Id                                  AS src_system_attr_id_value,
	  CASE WHEN External_System_Name__c is not null THEN External_System_Name__c 
        else  'N/A' 
      END AS upstream_src_system,
      'LeadObjectId'                      AS upstream_src_system_attr_id,
	  CASE WHEN External_System_Id__c is not null THEN External_System_Id__c 
        else 'N/A' end  AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
      cast(CreatedDate   as timestamp)    AS src_system_cre_date,
      current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily`
    ) x
      left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,
      x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),
      x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''),
      x.src_system_cre_date)) = s3track.hashdiff 
  );

  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
    WITH filtered_data AS (
      WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
      SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
      FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
      )
      SELECT
      source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
      destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
      FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
      INNER JOIN  
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
      and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
      LEFT JOIN
      deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
      ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
      LEFT JOIN
      deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
      ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
    )
    SELECT
      rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM
      filtered_data;
  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead`
  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
    WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
      SELECT
      source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
      FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
      LEFT JOIN
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
      ON
      source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
    )
    SELECT
      rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
      ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM
      filtered_lead_data;

  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid              AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
          IFNULL(Name,''),IFNULL(Company,''),IFNULL(Street,''),IFNULL(City,''),IFNULL(State,''),
          IFNULL(PostalCode,''),IFNULL(Country,''),IFNULL(Phone,''),IFNULL(Email,''))) as hashdiff,
      Name                                AS name,
      Street                              AS address,
      City                                AS city,
      State                               AS state,
      PostalCode                          AS postal_code,
      Phone                               AS phone,
      Email                               AS email,
      current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date,
      Company                             AS company, -- GCP rtx_lead_contact table add company column as it doesn't exist.
      Country                             AS country      
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` lead
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    WHERE 
      IsConverted = FALSE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid              AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
          IFNULL(con.Name,''),IFNULL(acc.Name,''),IFNULL(acc.BillingStreet,''),IFNULL(acc.BillingCity,''),
          IFNULL(acc.BillingState,''),IFNULL(acc.BillingPostalCode,''),IFNULL(acc.BillingCountry,''),IFNULL(acc.Phone,''),
          IFNULL(con.Email,''))) as hashdiff,
      con.Name                            AS name,
      acc.BillingStreet                   AS address,
      acc.BillingCity                     AS city,
      acc.BillingState                    AS state,
      acc.BillingPostalCode               AS postal_code,
      acc.Phone                           AS phone,
      con.Email                           AS email,
      current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date,
      acc.Name                             AS company, -- GCP rtx_lead_contact table add company column as it doesn't exist.
      acc.BillingCountry                  AS country
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` lead
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Account_Daily` acc,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Contact_Daily` con
    WHERE
      acc.id = lead.ConvertedAccountId
      AND con.AccountId = acc.id 
      AND lead.IsConverted = TRUE
  );

  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals`
    insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (
	SELECT
		t.rtx_lead_uid AS rtx_lead_uid,
		`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(t.rtx_lead_uid,		
       IF(t.eff_date IS NULL,'', cast(t.eff_date as string)),
       IFNULL(t.StageName,''),qli.Product_Code__c,
		COALESCE(qli.Quantity,0),
		(COALESCE(qli.Corrective_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) + 
		COALESCE(qli.InitialMaint_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) +
		COALESCE(qli.Merchandise_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) +
		COALESCE(qli.Total_Annual_Cost__c,0)) 
		)) as hashdiff,
		t.eff_date AS eff_date,
		--t.StageName,
		qli.Product_Code__c	AS service_line_code,
		CAST(COALESCE(qli.Quantity,0) AS INTEGER) AS quantity,
		CAST(COALESCE(qli.Corrective_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) + 
		COALESCE(qli.InitialMaint_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) +
		COALESCE(qli.Merchandise_User_Edited_Net_Price__c,0) +
		COALESCE(qli.Total_Annual_Cost__c,0) as NUMERIC)  AS service_amount,
		current_timestamp() AS cre_date
	FROM (
		SELECT
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid	AS rtx_lead_uid,
			opp.id  AS Id,
			opphis.CreatedDate AS eff_date,
			opphis.StageName,
			opp.Quote_Total_Cost__c,
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY opp.Id ORDER BY opphis.CreatedDate DESC) AS rn
		FROM
			`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead
		INNER JOIN
			`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp
			ON lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = opp.Id
		INNER JOIN
			`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_OpportunityHistory_Daily` AS opphis
			ON opp.Id = opphis.OpportunityId
	    INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
		INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
		INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
		WHERE
			opphis.StageName = 'Propose'
			AND opp.First_Presented_Date__c IS NOT NULL
	) t
	LEFT JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Quote_Daily` quo
		ON quo.OpportunityId =t.Id
	LEFT JOIN
		`bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_RTXSF_QuoteLineItem_Daily` qli
		ON qli.QuoteId = quo.Id 
	WHERE
		t.rn = 1  
    );
 
  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` (
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid                 AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
        IF(opp.CloseDate IS NULL,'', cast(opp.CloseDate as string))
        ,quo.LineItemCount,opp.Quote_Total_Cost__c,
        (opp.Quote_Total_Corrective_Amount__c + opp.Quote_Total_InitialMaint_Amount__c),
        opp.Quote_Total_Recurring_Cost__c,opp.Quote_Total_Merchandise_Amount__c)) as hashdiff,
      cast(opp.CloseDate as timestamp)                      AS eff_date,
      CAST(quo.LineItemCount as Integer)                        AS quantity,
      CAST(opp.Quote_Total_Cost__c as NUMERIC)                  AS total_amount,
      CAST(opp.Quote_Total_Corrective_Amount__c + opp.Quote_Total_InitialMaint_Amount__c as NUMERIC)   AS job_amount,
      CAST(opp.Quote_Total_Recurring_Cost__c as NUMERIC)        AS contract_amount,
      CAST(opp.Quote_Total_Merchandise_Amount__c as NUMERIC)    AS product_amount,
      current_timestamp()                    AS cre_date
    FROM 
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Quote_Daily` AS quo
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    WHERE 
      lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = opp.Id 
      AND quo.OpportunityId=opp.Id
      AND StageName='Closed Won'
	  AND opp.CloseDate is not null
  );
  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sale_link`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sale_link` (
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid                 AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
        'SFRTX','quote_number',IFNULL(quo.QuoteNumber,''))) as hashdiff,
      'SFRTX'                                AS sale_system,
      'quote_number'                         AS sale_system_attr_id,
      quo.QuoteNumber                        AS sale_system_attr_id_value,
      current_timestamp()                    AS cre_date
    FROM 
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Quote_Daily` AS quo
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    WHERE 
      lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = opp.Id 
      AND quo.OpportunityId=opp.Id
     -- AND opp.StageName='Closed Won' 
     	  AND opp.CloseDate is not null
  );

  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections`
    --(As SF doesn't have inspection related information hence skipping populating this table)
  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid                       AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
        IFNULL(ry.Name,''),
        IFNULL(lead.Lead_Type__c,''),
        IFNULL(lead.LeadSource,''),
        IFNULL(lead.Primary_Product_Interest__c,''))) as hashdiff,
      ry.Name                             AS market_type,
      lead.Lead_Type__c                   AS lead_type,
      lead.LeadSource                     AS lead_source,
      lead.Primary_Product_Interest__c    AS primary_pest,
      current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_RecordType_Daily` AS ry
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    Where lead.RecordTypeId = ry.Id 
  );
  
  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (

      and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Scheduled') 
    
    UNION ALL
    select
      rtx_lead_uid  AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Marketing_Qualified_Lead')) as hashdiff,
      eff_date,
      'Marketing_Qualified_Lead' as stage,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
      from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
      where i.stage = 'Sales_Qualified_Lead'
      and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead') 
    );
   INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
      rtx_lead_uid   AS rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Contacts')) as hashdiff,
      eff_date,
      'Contacts' as stage,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
      from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
      where i.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'
      and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Contacts') 

  );


  --Populate Table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status`
  insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
    SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid   AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,opphis.CreatedDate,
    CASE opphis.StageName
      WHEN 'New' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN 'Closed Lost' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      WHEN 'Closed Won' THEN 'Closed Won'
    END))  as hashdiff,
    cast(opphis.CreatedDate as timestamp)  AS eff_date, 
    CASE opphis.StageName
      WHEN 'New' THEN 'Open'
      WHEN 'Closed Lost' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      WHEN 'Closed Won' THEN 'Closed Won'
    END                                 AS status,
    current_timestamp()                 AS cre_date
    FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_OpportunityHistory_Daily` AS opphis
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    WHERE
      lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = opphis.OpportunityId
      AND opphis.StageName in ('New','Closed Won','Closed Lost')

      union all

     SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid         AS rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
         'Cancelled',opp.Loss_Reason__c)) as hashdiff,
      coalesce(cast(opp.Closed_Lost_Timestamp__c as timestamp),opp.CreatedDate)                     AS eff_date,
      'Cancelled'                     AS status,
      current_timestamp()                      AS cre_date
  FROM
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Lead_Daily` AS lead,
      `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.Raw_RTXSF_Opportunity_Daily` AS opp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on lead.Id = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  WHERE
      lead.ConvertedOpportunityId = opp.Id
      AND opp.Loss_Reason__c is not null
  );

  

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental_SFRTX_v1 stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

BEGIN																					   
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Query to populate S2 tmx layer
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

--rtx_lead_source_system_tracker
--log of leads from various source systems with their system unique id and anupstream system unique id if available for deduping
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` (
  SELECT 
  COALESCE(s3track.rtx_lead_sid,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_sid,
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) as hashdiff,
  x.src_system,
  x.src_system_attr_id,
  x.src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.upstream_src_system,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,
  x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
  x.src_system_cre_date,
  x.cre_date,
  from 
  (
  SELECT
      'TDW' AS src_system,
      'ACTID' as src_system_attr_id,
      cast (l.ACTID as string) AS src_system_attr_id_value,
      CASE WHEN external_lead_id is not null THEN 'TMLE' 
        else  'N/A' 
        END AS upstream_src_system,  
        CASE WHEN external_lead_id is not null THEN 'TMLELeadUID' 
        else 'N/A' 
        end as upstream_src_system_attr_id,
        CASE WHEN external_lead_id is not null THEN external_lead_id 
        else 'N/A' end  AS upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,
      l.received_date as src_system_cre_date,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l 
    where l.curr_ind = 'Y' 
	) x
     left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` s3track on 
	 `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(x.src_system,x.src_system_attr_id,x.src_system_attr_id_value,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system,'')
  ,IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id,''),IFNULL(x.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value,''))) = s3track.hashdiff 
);
--rtx_lead_uid_association
--leads are deduped/associated with their entries from various systems so that multiplertx_lead_sids are mapped toa single rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` (rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,rtx_lead_uid,cre_date)
WITH filtered_data AS (
	WITH deduplicated_uid_association AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_system_attr_id_value) AS row_num
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_uid_association`
  )
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value,
	`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(source_table.rtx_lead_sid,source_table.src_system_attr_id_value)) as hashdiff, 
  destination_table.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid,destination_table1.rtx_lead_uid as source_uid1
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` source_table
  INNER JOIN  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead_source_system_map`  m on source_table.src_system = m.src_system
    and source_table.upstream_src_system = m.upstream_src_system
  LEFT JOIN
    deduplicated_uid_association destination_table
  ON source_table.src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table.row_num = 1
  LEFT JOIN
     deduplicated_uid_association destination_table1
  ON source_table.upstream_src_system_attr_id_value = destination_table1.src_system_attr_id_value AND destination_table1.row_num = 1
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_sid,src_system_attr_id_value,hashdiff,COALESCE(source_uid,source_uid1,GENERATE_UUID()) as rtx_lead_uid,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_data;

--rtx_lead
--unique lead table: one record per rtx_lead_uid
INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` (rtx_lead_uid,hashdiff,cre_date)
WITH filtered_lead_data AS (
  SELECT
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid,
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` source_table
  LEFT JOIN
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S3.rtx_lead` destination_table
  ON
    source_table.rtx_lead_uid = destination_table.rtx_lead_uid
)
SELECT
  rtx_lead_uid,`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(rtx_lead_uid)
  ,current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM
  filtered_lead_data;
  
--rtx_lead_contact
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_contact` (
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete contact info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid */

/*TDW*/
SELECT 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,concat(IFNULL(lp.last_name,''),', ',IFNULL(lp.first_Name,'')),
IFNULL(lp.address_1,''),
IFNULL(lp.city,''),
IFNULL(lp.state_code,''),
IFNULL(lp.postal_code,''),
IFNULL(coalesce(lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone),''),
IFNULL(coalesce(lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3),'')
)) as hashdiff,
concat(lp.last_name,', ',lp.first_Name) as name,
lp.address_1 as address,
lp.city as city,
lp.state_code as state,
lp.postal_code as postal_code,
coalesce(lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone) as phone,
coalesce(lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3) as email,
current_timestamp() as cre_date,
		null AS company,
    null AS country 
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on lead.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID

where --lead.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 
);



--rtx_lead_proposals
--log of proposals made, TDW has service line granularity
insert into   `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_proposals` (

select 
rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
`bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
IFNULL(sl.service_line_code,''),
sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity), 
sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount))) as hashdiff,
cast(min(laf.activity_date) as timestamp) as eff_date,
sl.service_line_code,
sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity) as quantity, 
sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount) as service_value,
current_timestamp() as cre_date
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf --use laf.udt_date for incremental
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea2 on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea2.TMX_lead_activity_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l on laf.TMX_lead_SID = l.TMX_lead_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(l.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on l.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on laf.proposal_service_line_sid = sl.tmx_sa_item_service_line_sid
where lea2.lead_status_code IN ('PRP','PRH') 
and laf.activity_date >=  cast(date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
--and l.received_date >= '2024-01-01'
--and l.curr_ind = 'Y' --SC0 1/23/2025 fix for sum of all proposals 
group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, sl.service_line_code 
);


--rtx_lead_inspections 
--log of two activity types, an inspection being scheduled, and and inpsection being inspected ie completed
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_inspections` (

SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	'Scheduled',min(lead.scheduled_date))) as hashdiff,
    cast(max(date_trunc(leaf.udt_date,day)) as timestamp) as eff_date, 
    'Scheduled' as activity_type,
    min(lead.scheduled_date) as activity_date,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID  
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` leaf on lead.TMX_lead_SID = leaf.TMX_lead_SID
  where
      lea.lead_status_code IN ('SCH','SCI')
      --and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
  group by 
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

union all
SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
	cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp),
	'Inspected',
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp))) as hashdiff,
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp) as eff_date, 
    'Inspected' as activity_type,
    cast(max(lead.curr_inspected_date) as timestamp) as activity_date,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  where
  curr_inspected_date is not null
  --and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
  group by 
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

);


--rtx_lead_sales
--sum of all raw sales made from the lead
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_sales` (
select 
			rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,min(accounting_date),sum(i.rawsale_amt))) as hashdiff,
			min(accounting_date) as eff_date,
			--i.sales_agreement_number,
			sum(case when sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC') then 1 else 0 end )as quantity,
			sum(i.rawsale_amt) as total_amount,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('SPC') and sl.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0  end )as job_amount ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('INI','REG','BIT') and sl.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH')  then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end )as contract_amount,
			sum(case when sl.service_line_code in ('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end) as product_amount ,
			current_timestamp() as cre_date
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` sat ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = sat.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
			inner Join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
			inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast(l2.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
      inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
			left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_customer` c on i.tmx_customer_sid = c.tmx_customer_sid
			where
			((sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','REG','BIT') AND sl.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) OR (sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','BIT'/*,'RNL' excluding renewals 12-11-2023 per Rob Fuller*/) AND sl.service_line1_short = 'TC'))
			and i.curr_ind='Y' 
			and i.rawsale_amt > 0
			and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
					inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on LAF.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
					group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid--l2.actid--, i.sales_agreement_number
);


--rtx_lead_field_assignment
--log of relevant fields that we need to track changes to
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` (
  /*Assigned Branch*/
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'assigned_branch',IFNULL(abu.buncod_id,''))) as hashdiff,
  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,
  'assigned_branch' as field,
  abu.buncod_id as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y' and lower(abu.bu_type_classification) in ('not specified','sales center','service center') and abu.buncod_id is not null

union all

  /* 'originating_branch' TDW*/
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'originating_branch',IFNULL(abu.buncod_id,''))) as hashdiff,
  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,--'load_date' as eff_date, ( we need the timestamp when the record was staged)
  'originating_branch' as field,
  abu.buncod_id as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.originating_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y' and abu.buncod_id is not null

  union all
/* 'assigned_employee' */


  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'assigned_employee',e.employee_jde_number)) as hashdiff,
  rtx_leads.cre_date as eff_date,--'load_date' as eff_date, ( we need the timestamp when the record was staged)
  'assigned_employee' as field,
  cast(e.employee_jde_number as string) as field_value,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date
  FROM
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` e on lead.curr_assigned_employee_sid = e.tmx_employee_sid
  where 
  --l.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
  lead.curr_ind = 'Y' and e.employee_jde_number is not null

union all

--rtx_lead_attributes
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid*/
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(lp.market_type,''),IFNULL(la.lead_type_code,''),
      IFNULL(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,''),IFNULL(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,''),
      IFNULL(k8425.OPS_bunit,''),IFNULL(la.lead_source_code,''),IFNULL(la.item_code,''))) as hashdiff,
  case  when lp.market_type = 'RES' then 'Residential'
        when lp.market_type = 'COM' then 'Commercial'
        else lp.market_type end as market_type,
  la.lead_type_code AS `lead_type`,
  CASE
    WHEN lead_source_code in ('YELP','LSA') then lead_source_code
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8312' THEN 'Chat'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1996' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1992' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1998' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1901' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1074' THEN 'Lead Forms'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8601' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN k8425.OPS_bunit = '8425' THEN 'Field – CSC PIG'
    WHEN la.lead_source_code = 'PIG' THEN 'Field-PIG' 
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8441' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN LEFT(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,1) = '8' AND cb.createdby = 'Inside Sales'  then 'Calls-ISP'
    WHEN LEFT(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,1) = '8' AND lower(cb.createdby) like '%customer%'  then 'Calls-CCR'
    WHEN la.lead_source_code = 'CROSS' THEN 'Calls-Cross'
    WHEN LEFT(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,1) = '8' THEN 'Calls'
    WHEN cb.createdby = 'Inside Sales' then 'Field-ISP'
    WHEN lower(cb.createdby) like '%commercial%' then 'Field-CSP'
    WHEN lower(la.lead_type_code) like '%inb%' then 'Other'
  ELSE
  'Field'
END
  AS `lead_source`,
  la.item_code AS `primary_pest`,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date,
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` obu on lead.originating_BUnit_SID = obu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on lead.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID
  left join (
          select rtx_lead_uid, 
          assignment_value as createdby
          from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_field_assignment` a 
          where assignment_type = 'creating_employee_designation'
          qualify row_number() over (partition by rtx_lead_uid,assignment_type order by cre_date desc )=1 ) cb on rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid = cb.rtx_lead_uid 
  left join (
					SELECT
					 le.ACTID,
						OE.home_BUnit AS OPS_bunit
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on laf.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` le on laf.TMX_lead_SID = le.TMX_lead_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` oe on laf.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
				where
				lea.lead_status_code IN ('ASG','ASH','RQS','SCH','SCI')
				AND LA.lead_source_code = 'PIG' --- not service sale
				 and le.received_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
				 AND OE.home_BUnit = '8425'
				group by 
				le.ACTID,
					OE.home_BUnit
			) as k8425 on lead.ACTID = k8425.ACTID
      where 
      --lead.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
      lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 
);
