--rtx_lead_attributes
/* this table probably needs to change to type 2 - we want to be able to update with more complete info as lead moves into later systems. This will also require a MV flattening with most current non null values for uid*/
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` (
  SELECT
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(lp.market_type,''),IFNULL(la.lead_type_code,''),
      IFNULL(oBu.curr_division_code,''),IFNULL(oBu.BUNCOD_ID,''),
      IFNULL(k8425.OPS_bunit,''),IFNULL(la.lead_source_code,''),IFNULL(la.item_code,''))) as hashdiff,
  case  when lp.market_type = 'RES' then 'Residential'
        when lp.market_type = 'COM' then 'Commercial'
        else lp.market_type end as market_type,
  la.lead_type_code AS `lead_type`,
  CASE
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1996' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1992' THEN 'E-comm'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1998' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.curr_division_code = '1901' THEN 'Summer Sales'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1074' THEN 'Lead Forms'
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8601' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN k8425.OPS_bunit = '8425' THEN 'Field – CSC PIG'
    WHEN la.lead_source_code = 'PIG' THEN 'Field-PIG' 
    WHEN oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8441' THEN 'Appt_Set'
    WHEN LEFT(oBu.curr_division_code,1) = '8' THEN 'Calls'
  ELSE
  'Field'
END
  AS `lead_source`,
  la.item_code AS `primary_pest`,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date,
FROM 
  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` obu on lead.originating_BUnit_SID = obu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_business_unit` abu on lead.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on lead.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID
  left join (
					SELECT
					 le.ACTID,
						OE.home_BUnit AS OPS_bunit
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes` la on laf.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` le on laf.TMX_lead_SID = le.TMX_lead_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_employee` oe on laf.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
				where
				lea.lead_status_code IN ('ASG','ASH','RQS','SCH','SCI')
				AND LA.lead_source_code = 'PIG' --- not service sale
				 and le.received_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
				 AND OE.home_BUnit = '8425'
				group by 
				le.ACTID,
					OE.home_BUnit
			) as k8425 on lead.ACTID = k8425.ACTID
      where 
      --lead.received_date >= '2024-01-01' and 
      lead.curr_ind = 'Y' 

--SCO LE addition 8/29/2024
  union all
  select
  rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid, -- this will be rtx_lead_uid
  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(CustomerType,''),
    IFNULL(null,''),
    IFNULL(LeadSource,''),
    IFNULL(ReasonforContact,''))) as hashdiff,
  case CustomerType 
        when  'Residential' then 'RES'
        when 'Business' then 'COM' 
        else CustomerType
    end as market_type, --has one bad record with value 'jaRoy' from October 2023
  null as lead_type, --not available in le
  LeadSource as lead_source,
  ReasonforContact as primary_pest,
  current_timestamp() as cre_date 
 FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.LeadsExecAPIExtract`  le 
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (le.UID as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  
--SCO SE addition 8/27/2024
  union all
  select

  `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,IFNULL(CustomerType,''),
    IFNULL(MarketingChannel,''),
    IFNULL(LeadSource,''),
    IFNULL(ReasonforContact,''))) as hashdiff,
  case CustomerType 
        when  'Residential' then 'RES'

    end as market_type, --has one bad record with value 'jaRoy' from October 2023

			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
      inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` (
    select
    rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_lead_uid,'Contacts')) as hashdiff,
    eff_date,
    'Contacts' as stage,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` i
    where i.stage = 'Marketing_Qualified_Lead'
    and not exists(select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = i.rtx_lead_uid  and s.stage = 'Contacts') 
)
;

--rtx_lead_status
--log of lead entering statuses
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` (
   /* OPEN */
 	 /*TDW & LPP & SE & LE Open*/ 
  select 
    leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(leads.rtx_lead_uid,track.src_system_cre_date,'Open')) as hashdiff,
    cast(track.src_system_cre_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Open' AS status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` as track,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` as assoc,
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` as leads
  where track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
   and assoc.rtx_lead_uid = leads.rtx_lead_uid
   and not exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_status` status 
   where status.rtx_lead_UID = leads.rtx_lead_uid)

  /* Cancelled */

    /*SE Cancelled*/ --SCO SE addition 8/29/2024
union all

    SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
    cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Cancelled' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Cancelled'
  

  /*TDW Cancelled*/
  union all
  SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,coalesce(min(lead.cancel_date),min(lead.cre_date)),'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
		coalesce(min(lead.cancel_date),min(lead.cre_date)) as eff_date, 
    'Cancelled' as status,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
	from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes`  la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
		left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID and lea.lead_status_code IN ('CNL')
 	where
		trim(la.cancel_reason_description) != '' 
  	--and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
	group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

  /*LPP Cancelled*/
  union all
    SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(CONCAT(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,CAST(pp.LostRejectDate AS DATE),'Cancelled')) as hashdiff,
      pp.LostRejectDate as eff_date, 
      'Cancelled' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
    from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    where pp.LostRejectDate is not null

  /*TDW Open - UnCancelled */
  union all
  SELECT
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
      `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(min(lead.cre_date) as timestamp),'Open')) as hashdiff,
      cast(min(lead.cre_date) as timestamp) as eff_date, -- date lead entered stage,only covering first entry 
     'Open' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
  	from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
		inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_attributes`  la on lead.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
		left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead_activity` lea on lead.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID 
    where lea.lead_status_code IN ('UCN')
      --and l.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
    group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

  /* Closed Won */
  /*TDW Closed Won */
  union all
  SELECT
		rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,cast(min(lead.sold_date) as timestamp),'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
		cast(min(lead.sold_date) as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
		current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
	where lead.sold_date is not null
	--and lead.received_date >=  '2024-01-01'
	group by rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid

union all 
   /*SE Closed Won*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Sold'

  /* LPP Closed Won */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.WonDate,'Closed Won')) as hashdiff,
    pp.WonDate as eff_date, 
    'Closed Won' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.WonDate is not null

  /*TDW Closed Lost*/
  union all
  select 
      rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid, 
       `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
      case  when la.market_type = 'RES' and date_diff(current_timestamp(),s.eff_date,day) > 30 then current_timestamp 
            when la.market_type <> 'RES' and date_diff(current_timestamp(),s.eff_date,day) > 180 then current_timestamp 
            else null 
      end as eff_date,
      'Closed Lost' as status,
      current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.tmx_lead` lead
	inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on cast (lead.actid as string) = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_attributes` la on la.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s on s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and stage = 'Proposed'
   where not exists ( select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_stage` s where s.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid and stage = 'Sold' )

   union all
      /*SE Closed Lost*/
      SELECT
  	rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    cast(LastUpdate_date as timestamp) as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
    FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.SalesExecAPIExtract` se 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` track on se.LeadUID = track.src_system_attr_id_value 
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on track.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
    inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_leads_SE_stage` map on concat('SE|',upper(se.Status)) = upper(map.Key)
    and map.Lead_Status ='Lost'

  /* LPP Closed Lost */
  union all
  SELECT
    rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid as rtx_lead_uid,  
    `bidata-sharedus-production`.Functions.convertStringToHashkey(concat(rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid,pp.dlClosedDate,'Closed Lost')) as hashdiff,
    pp.dlClosedDate as eff_date,
    'Closed Lost' as status,
    current_timestamp() as cre_date
  from `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.ProspectPipelineNA9` pp
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_source_system_tracker` lm on pp.ProspectNumber = lm.src_system_attr_id_value
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead_uid_association` assoc on lm.rtx_lead_sid = assoc.rtx_lead_sid
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.rtx_lead` rtx_leads on assoc.rtx_lead_uid = rtx_leads.rtx_lead_uid
  where pp.dlClosedDate is not null and pp.WonDate is null

);

EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
RAISE USING message = FORMAT("Exception occured leads_tmx_incremental stored procedure", @@error.statement_text, @@error.formatted_stack_trace, @@error.message);
END

begin

declare row_count int64 ;
declare snap_date date;
set snap_date =  DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(date_sub(current_date(), interval 5 day), month),interval  1 month), interval 1 day);--'2023-01-31'; set to last day of month completed
 --create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_detail`  -
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_detail` -- use this for sp
SELECT 
'TDW' as src_system,
cast(date_add(snap_date, interval 1 day) as timestamp) as snp_date,
current_datetime as insert_date,
sales_agreement_number as contract_id,
--i.effective_date,
sl.service_line_code as service_code, 
ia.report_market_type as market_type,
b.BUNCOD_ID as business_unit,
ia.classification_code as class_code,
ad.postal_code as zip,
SUM(annual_value) AS annual_value,
COUNT(*) AS base_quantity
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = ia.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
 left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad on i.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID 

WHERE
date_add(cast(snap_date as timestamp), interval 1 day) between i.eff_date and i.end_date and 
(cast(snap_date as timestamp) between effective_date and inactive_date) and
(cast(snap_date as timestamp) < cancel_date or cancel_date is null) and
i.raw_sale_yn = 'N' and
i.billable_yn = 'Y'
and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL')

GROUP BY
ACTID, 
sales_agreement_number,
i.effective_date,
sl.service_line_code,
ia.report_market_type,
b.BUNCOD_ID,
ia.classification_code,
ad.postal_code,
b.BUNCOD_ID
;

;

end

partition by
date(activity_date)
AS(*/
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_activity_detail`

current_datetime as insert_date,
f.upd_date,
'TDW' as src_system,
i.actid as contract_activity_id,
i.sales_agreement_number as contract_id,
f.activity_date,
f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID as activity_type,
--sia.SA_item_activity_name1 IGNORE

ad.postal_code as zip,

      else SUM(f.annual_value) 
end as activity_amount,
SUM(f.activity_quantity) as activity_quantity

--inner join TMX_SA_conversion c on f.TMX_SA_conversion_SID = c.TMX_SA_conversion_SID IGNORE
--inner join time t on f.activity_date_SID = t.TIME_SID IGNORE
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b on f.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON f.tmx_sa_item_attributes_SID = ia.tmx_sa_item_attributes_sid

--joins that I added
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad on f.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID 
 --inner join `S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity` sia on f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = sia.TMX_SA_activity_SID IGNORE
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
 /*exclude out of scope activities*/
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = m.TMX_SA_activity_SID  
WHERE f.activity_date_SID >= extract(year from (current_date()))*100 + 1 /* limiting to a few months for dev, use following code for initial load: extract(year from (current_date()))*100 + 1 */ 
and
(
( f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 -- exclude collections
and ia.service_type_code <> 'SPC')
OR
(f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 and f.initial_value <> 0 and ia.service_type_code = 'SPC')
)
and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL')
and f.upd_date > (select max(upd_date) from bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_activity_detail)-- LEAVE OUT for initial load 0 but include for incremenatl stored procedure

GROUP BY
f.upd_date,
f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID,
f.TMX_SA_attributes_SID,
f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID,
f.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID,
f.local_currency_SID,
b.BUNCOD_ID,
f.activity_date,
i.sales_agreement_number,
--sia.SA_item_activity_name1,
sl.service_line_code,
ia.report_market_type,
ia.classification_code,
ad.postal_code,
i.actid,
m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification

;

;

;

  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY contract_activity_id, activity_amount, activity_type, activity_date ORDER BY upd_date DESC ) as rn

;

BEGIN

create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_rto_sales_kpi`
partition by
date(`Received Date`)
AS(
Select 
l.ACTID,
'TMX' as Business, --TMXIndicator,
abu.curr_division_name as Division,
abu.curr_region_name as Region,
concat(abu.BUNCOD_ID,' - ',abu.branch_name) as Branch,
lp.market_type as `Market Type`,
la.lead_type_code as `Lead Type`,
	CASE
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1996' then 'E-comm'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1992' then 'E-comm'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1998' then 'Summer Sales'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1901' then 'Summer Sales'
            when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1074' then 'Lead Forms'
            when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8601' then 'Appt_Set'
		    when k8425.OPS_bunit = '8425'  then 'Field – CSC PIG' --- added by KK on 20221031
			when la.lead_source_code = 'PIG' then 'Field-PIG'     --- added by KK on 20221031
			when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8441' then 'Appt_Set'
			when LEFT(oBu.curr_division_code,1) = '8' then 'Calls'
 			else 'Field' 
	end as `Lead Channel`,--SalesChannel,
la.item_code as `Target Pest`,
la.item_code_description as `Target Pest Description`,
concat(lp.last_name,', ',lp.first_Name) as Prospect,
coalesce(csva.phone,lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone) as `Phone #`,--CombinedPhone,
coalesce(csva.email,lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3) as email,
lp.address_1 as Address,
lp.city,
lp.state_code as State,
lp.postal_code as Zip,
ce.CreatedBy_Employee,
ce.CreatedBy_JDE,
ce.CreatedBy_EmployeeBranch,
ce.CreatedBy_JobCodeName,
coalesce( se.Common_name , e.Common_name ) as `Assigned-Selling Employee`, 
coalesce( se.employee_JDE_number ,e.employee_JDE_number)  as `Selling-Assigned JDE`, 
coalesce(se.home_BUnit, e.home_BUnit) as `Selling-Assigned Employee Branch`,
coalesce( jcr2.JobCodesName , jcr.JobCodesName ) as `Job codes name`,--jcr.JobCodesName as `Job codes name`,--coalesce( jcr2.JobCodesName , jcr.JobCodesName ) as `Job codes name`,
/*CASE 
			when l.curr_cancel_date is not null then '8.Cancelled'
			when csva.Start_Date is not null then '7. Won (Serviced Commenced)'
			when l.curr_sold_date is not null then '6. Won (Pending Service)'
			when 
				CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, ClosedWonLostDate 
					when l.curr_sold_date is not null then l.curr_sold_date
					when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
					when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and getdate() - curr_proposed_date > 21 then dateadd(dd,21,l.curr_proposed_date)
					when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and getdate() - curr_proposed_date > 180 then dateadd(dd,180,l.curr_proposed_date)
				else null 
				END  is not null then '5.Lost/Rejected'
			when l.proposed_date is not null then '4. Inspection & Open Proposal'
			when coalesce(l.curr_inspected_date, l.curr_complete_date) is not null then '3. Inspection - No Proposal'
			when l.curr_scheduled_date is not null then '2. Visit Scheduled'
			else '1. Lead Received'
	END as 'Lead Status',*/
    l.received_date as `Received Date`,
l.curr_scheduled_date as `Scheduled Date`,
CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, LeadPerformedDate
			when l.curr_scheduled_date is null and l.curr_proposed_date is not null then l.curr_proposed_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date > l.received_date then curr_inspected_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date and l.curr_scheduled_date > l.received_date then l.curr_scheduled_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date and l.curr_scheduled_date < l.received_date then l.curr_proposed_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date then l.curr_proposed_date
			else null
	END as `Lead Performed Date`,
l.curr_proposed_date as `Proposed Date`,
l.curr_sold_date as `Sold Date`,
CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, ClosedWonLostDate
			when l.curr_sold_date is not null then l.curr_sold_date
			when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 30 day)
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 180 day)
			else null
	END as `Closed Won-Lost Date`,
	CASE		
			when l.cancel_date is not null then l.cancel_date
      when length(la.cancel_reason_code) >1 then coalesce(l.curr_sold_date,l.curr_proposed_date,l.curr_inspected_date, l.curr_complete_date,l.curr_scheduled_date,l.received_date)
      when l.curr_sold_date is not null then null
			when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 30 day)
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 180 day)
			else null
	END as `Lost-Rejected Date`,
	CASE		
			when la.cancel_reason_description is not null then la.cancel_reason_description
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then "Expired Quote (>30 days)"
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then "Expired Quote (>180 days)"
			else null
	END as `Lost Cancel Reason`,
csva.Start_Date as `Start Date`,
case when l.proposed_date is null and l.sold_date is null then 0 else 1 end as `Sum of Proposed Leads`, 
case when l.sold_date is null then 0 else 1 end as `Sum of Sold Leads`, 
pl.activity_quantity as `Proposed Products`,--SumProposedNetQty,
csva.QTY  as `Sold Products` , --as SumSoldQTY
pl.proposal_contract_amount as `Proposed Amount`, --SumProposal_contract_amount,
csva.rawsale_amt as `Sum of Raw Amount`,
case when csva.Start_Date is not null then csva.started_amt  else 0 end as `Started Amount`,
csva.Jobs as `Sold Job Amount`,
csva.Contracts as `Sold Contract Amount`,
csva.Products as `Sold Product Amount`
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` obu on l.originating_BUnit_SID = obu.TMX_business_unit_SID
left join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` abu on l.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID  
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_attributes` la on l.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on l.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on l.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` e on l.curr_assigned_employee_SID = e.TMX_employee_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on l.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_job_code_roles` jcr on e.job_code = jcr.job_code 
			 --lead to lead activity fact is one to many, so join with subquery grouping by ACTID to get sum of proposals (includes multiple proposal amounts for same product)
left join (select l2.ACTID,  sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity) as activity_quantity, sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount) as proposal_contract_amount
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
			inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea2 on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea2.TMX_lead_activity_SID
			inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l2 on laf.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
			where lea2.lead_status_code IN ('PRP','PRH') 
			and laf.activity_date >= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 3 year) as timestamp)
			group by l2.ACTID 
			) pl on l.ACTID = pl.ACTID--l.TMX_lead_SID = pl.TMX_lead_SID
			 --lead to sa_item is one to many (one lead multiple sales agreements), so join with subquery grouping by TMX_lead_SID to get sum raw and started sales amounts
left join (select 
			l2.ACTID, min(i.effective_date) as Start_Date, 
			sum(case when sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC') then 1 else 0 end )as QTY,
			sum(i.rawsale_amt) as rawsale_amt,
			sum(case when sl2.service_line_code in ('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end) as Products ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('SPC') and sl2.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0  end )as Jobs ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('INI','REG','BIT') and sl2.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH')  then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end )as Contracts,
			sum(case when i.effective_date is not null then i.rawsale_amt end) as started_amt,
			max(TMX_sales_employee_SID) as TMX_sales_employee_SID,
			max(c.email) as email,
			max(coalesce(c.mobile_phone,c.work_phone,c.home_phone)) as phone
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` sat ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = sat.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
			inner Join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl2 ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl2.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
			inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
			left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_customer` c on i.tmx_customer_sid = c.tmx_customer_sid
			where
			((sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','REG','BIT') AND sl2.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) OR (sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','BIT'/*,'RNL' excluding renewals 12-11-2023 per Rob Fuller*/) AND sl2.service_line1_short = 'TC'))
			and i.curr_ind='Y' 
			and i.rawsale_amt > 0
			and b.BU_type in ('Branch','Satellite Branch')
			and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
					inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on LAF.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 3 year) as timestamp))
			group by l2.ACTID
			) csva on  l.ACTID = csva.ACTID 
left join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` se on  
csva.TMX_sales_employee_SID = se.TMX_employee_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_job_code_roles` jcr2 on se.job_code = jcr2.job_code 
			----Add in query to find pig leads / sales that were modified by dept 8425 / added by KK 20221031
left join (
					SELECT
					 le.ACTID,
						OE.home_BUnit AS OPS_bunit
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_attributes` la on laf.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` le on laf.TMX_lead_SID = le.TMX_lead_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` oe on laf.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
				where
				lea.lead_status_code IN ('ASG','ASH','RQS','SCH','SCI')
				AND LA.lead_source_code = 'PIG' --- not service sale
				 and le.received_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 3 year) as timestamp)
				 AND OE.home_BUnit = '8425'
				group by 
				le.ACTID,
					OE.home_BUnit
			) as k8425 on l.ACTID = k8425.ACTID
left join (
					SELECT
					itemLd.ACTID
					,min(oe.common_name) as CreatedBy_Employee
					, min(employee_jde_number) as CreatedBy_JDE
					,min(home_bunit) as CreatedBy_EmployeeBranch
					,min(jcr.JobCodesName) as CreatedBy_JobCodeName
					from
							`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` as actfLd 
							inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` as itemLd  on actfLd.tmx_lead_sid = itemLd.tmx_lead_sid
							inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` as actvLd on actfLd.tmx_lead_activity_sid = actvLd.tmx_lead_activity_sid
							inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` oe on actfLd.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
							left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_job_code_roles` jcr on oe.job_code = jcr.job_code
					where 
							/* received activities */
							actvLd.lead_status_code = 'RQS'
							and actfLd.activity_date_SID > cast(format_date('%Y%m%d',  date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) ) as int)
							or
							(itemLd.eff_date <= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
							and itemLd.end_date >= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
							and itemLd.received_date >= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
							and itemLd.received_date <= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
							group by itemLd.actid
							) ce on ce.actid = l.actid				
where 
l.curr_ind = 'Y'
and l.received_date>= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
--and --sl.service_line_code <> 'WDIR' including WDIR as of 12-11-2023 Rob Fuller's request
--and cancel_date is null
and abu.BU_type = 'Branch'
);
end

BEGIN

create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_rto_sales_kpi`
partition by
date(`Received Date`)
AS(
Select 
l.ACTID,
'TMX' as Business, --TMXIndicator,
abu.curr_division_name as Division,
abu.curr_region_name as Region,
concat(abu.BUNCOD_ID,' - ',abu.branch_name) as Branch,
lp.market_type as `Market Type`,
la.lead_type_code as `Lead Type`,
	CASE
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1996' then 'E-comm'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1992' then 'E-comm'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1998' then 'Summer Sales'
            when oBu.curr_division_code = '1901' then 'Summer Sales'
            when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '1074' then 'Lead Forms'
            when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8601' then 'Appt_Set'
		    when k8425.OPS_bunit = '8425'  then 'Field – CSC PIG' --- added by KK on 20221031
			when la.lead_source_code = 'PIG' then 'Field-PIG'     --- added by KK on 20221031
			when oBu.BUNCOD_ID = '8441' then 'Appt_Set'
			when LEFT(oBu.curr_division_code,1) = '8' then 'Calls'
 			else 'Field' 
	end as `Lead Channel`,--SalesChannel,
la.item_code as `Target Pest`,
la.item_code_description as `Target Pest Description`,
concat(lp.last_name,', ',lp.first_Name) as Prospect,
coalesce(csva.phone,lp.mobile_phone,lp.work_phone,lp.home_phone) as `Phone #`,--CombinedPhone,
coalesce(csva.email,lp.email_1, lp.email_2,lp.email_3) as email,
lp.address_1 as Address,
lp.city,
lp.state_code as State,
lp.postal_code as Zip,
coalesce( se.Common_name , e.Common_name ) as `Assigned-Selling Employee`, 
coalesce( se.employee_JDE_number ,e.employee_JDE_number)  as `Selling-Assigned JDE`, 
coalesce(se.home_BUnit, e.home_BUnit) as `Selling-Assigned Employee Branch`,
coalesce( jcr2.JobCodesName , jcr.JobCodesName ) as `Job codes name`,--jcr.JobCodesName as `Job codes name`,--coalesce( jcr2.JobCodesName , jcr.JobCodesName ) as `Job codes name`,
/*CASE 
			when l.curr_cancel_date is not null then '8.Cancelled'
			when csva.Start_Date is not null then '7. Won (Serviced Commenced)'
			when l.curr_sold_date is not null then '6. Won (Pending Service)'
			when 
				CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, ClosedWonLostDate 
					when l.curr_sold_date is not null then l.curr_sold_date
					when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
					when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and getdate() - curr_proposed_date > 21 then dateadd(dd,21,l.curr_proposed_date)
					when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and getdate() - curr_proposed_date > 180 then dateadd(dd,180,l.curr_proposed_date)
				else null 
				END  is not null then '5.Lost/Rejected'
			when l.proposed_date is not null then '4. Inspection & Open Proposal'
			when coalesce(l.curr_inspected_date, l.curr_complete_date) is not null then '3. Inspection - No Proposal'
			when l.curr_scheduled_date is not null then '2. Visit Scheduled'
			else '1. Lead Received'
	END as 'Lead Status',*/
    l.received_date as `Received Date`,
l.curr_scheduled_date as `Scheduled Date`,
CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, LeadPerformedDate
			when l.curr_scheduled_date is null and l.curr_proposed_date is not null then l.curr_proposed_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date > l.received_date then curr_inspected_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date and l.curr_scheduled_date > l.received_date then l.curr_scheduled_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date and l.curr_scheduled_date < l.received_date then l.curr_proposed_date
			when l.curr_inspected_date = l.received_date then l.curr_proposed_date
			else null
	END as `Lead Performed Date`,
l.curr_proposed_date as `Proposed Date`,
l.curr_sold_date as `Sold Date`,
CASE		-- translated from RTO DAX logic, ClosedWonLostDate
			when l.curr_sold_date is not null then l.curr_sold_date
			when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 30 day)
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 180 day)
			else null
	END as `Closed Won-Lost Date`,
	CASE		
			when l.cancel_date is not null then l.cancel_date
      when length(la.cancel_reason_code) >1 then coalesce(l.curr_sold_date,l.curr_proposed_date,l.curr_inspected_date, l.curr_complete_date,l.curr_scheduled_date,l.received_date)
      when l.curr_sold_date is not null then null
			when l.curr_proposed_date is null then null
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 30 day)
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then date_add(l.curr_proposed_date, interval 180 day)
			else null
	END as `Lost-Rejected Date`,
	CASE		
			when la.cancel_reason_description is not null then la.cancel_reason_description
			when lp.market_type = 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date() as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date ,DAY)> 30 then "Expired Quote (>30 days)"
			when lp.market_type <> 'RES' and l.curr_proposed_date is not null and date_diff(cast(current_date()as timestamp) , curr_proposed_date, DAY) > 180 then "Expired Quote (>180 days)"
			else null
	END as `Lost Cancel Reason`,
csva.Start_Date as `Start Date`,
case when l.proposed_date is null and l.sold_date is null then 0 else 1 end as `Sum of Proposed Leads`, 
case when l.sold_date is null then 0 else 1 end as `Sum of Sold Leads`, 
pl.activity_quantity as `Proposed Products`,--SumProposedNetQty,
csva.QTY  as `Sold Products` , --as SumSoldQTY
pl.proposal_contract_amount as `Proposed Amount`, --SumProposal_contract_amount,
csva.rawsale_amt as `Sum of Raw Amount`,
case when csva.Start_Date is not null then csva.started_amt  else 0 end as `Started Amount`,
csva.Jobs as `Sold Job Amount`,
csva.Contracts as `Sold Contract Amount`,
csva.Products as `Sold Product Amount`
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` obu on l.originating_BUnit_SID = obu.TMX_business_unit_SID
left join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` abu on l.assigned_BUnit_SID = abu.TMX_business_unit_SID  
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_attributes` la on l.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on l.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_prospect` lp on l.TMX_lead_prospect_SID = lp.TMX_lead_prospect_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` e on l.curr_assigned_employee_SID = e.TMX_employee_SID
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on l.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_job_code_roles` jcr on e.job_code = jcr.job_code 
			 --lead to lead activity fact is one to many, so join with subquery grouping by ACTID to get sum of proposals (includes multiple proposal amounts for same product)
left join (select l2.ACTID,  sum(lea2.report_multiplier * laf.activity_quantity) as activity_quantity, sum(laf.proposal_contract_amount) as proposal_contract_amount
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
			inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea2 on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea2.TMX_lead_activity_SID
			inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l2 on laf.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
			where lea2.lead_status_code IN ('PRP','PRH') 
			and laf.activity_date >= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
			group by l2.ACTID 
			) pl on l.ACTID = pl.ACTID--l.TMX_lead_SID = pl.TMX_lead_SID
			 --lead to sa_item is one to many (one lead multiple sales agreements), so join with subquery grouping by TMX_lead_SID to get sum raw and started sales amounts
left join (select 
			l2.ACTID, min(i.effective_date) as Start_Date, 
			sum(case when sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC') then 1 else 0 end )as QTY,
			sum(i.rawsale_amt) as rawsale_amt,
			sum(case when sl2.service_line_code in ('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end) as Products ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('SPC') and sl2.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH') then i.rawsale_amt else 0  end )as Jobs ,
			sum(case when  sat.service_type_code in ('INI','REG','BIT') and sl2.service_line_code not in('PROD','MERCH')  then i.rawsale_amt else 0 end )as Contracts,
			sum(case when i.effective_date is not null then i.rawsale_amt end) as started_amt,
			max(TMX_sales_employee_SID) as TMX_sales_employee_SID,
			max(c.email) as email,
			max(coalesce(c.mobile_phone,c.work_phone,c.home_phone)) as phone
			from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` sat ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = sat.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
			inner Join`bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl2 ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl2.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
			inner Join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
			inner join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` l2 on i.TMX_lead_SID = l2.TMX_lead_SID
			left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_customer` c on i.tmx_customer_sid = c.tmx_customer_sid
			where
			((sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','REG','BIT') AND sl2.service_line1_short IN ('PC','PM')) OR (sat.service_type_code in ('INI','SPC','BIT'/*,'RNL' excluding renewals 12-11-2023 per Rob Fuller*/) AND sl2.service_line1_short = 'TC'))
			and i.curr_ind='Y' 
			and i.rawsale_amt > 0
			and b.BU_type in ('Branch','Satellite Branch')
			and exists (select 1 from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf 
					inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on LAF.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
					where laf.sales_agreement_number =cast( i.sales_agreement_number as string) and lea.lead_status_code in ('SLD' )
					and laf.activity_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp))
			group by l2.ACTID
			) csva on  l.ACTID = csva.ACTID 
left join  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` se on  
csva.TMX_sales_employee_SID = se.TMX_employee_SID
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.vw_job_code_roles` jcr2 on se.job_code = jcr2.job_code 
			----Add in query to find pig leads / sales that were modified by dept 8425 / added by KK 20221031
left join (
					SELECT
					 le.ACTID,
						OE.home_BUnit AS OPS_bunit
					from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity_fact` laf
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_attributes` la on laf.TMX_lead_attribute_SID  = la.TMX_lead_attribute_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead` le on laf.TMX_lead_SID = le.TMX_lead_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_lead_activity` lea on laf.TMX_lead_activity_SID = lea.TMX_lead_activity_SID
				inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_employee` oe on laf.operation_employee_SID = oe.TMX_employee_SID
				where
				lea.lead_status_code IN ('ASG','ASH','RQS','SCH','SCI')
				AND LA.lead_source_code = 'PIG' --- not service sale
				 and le.received_date >=  cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 2 year) as timestamp)
				 AND OE.home_BUnit = '8425'
				group by 
				le.ACTID,
					OE.home_BUnit
			) as k8425 on l.ACTID = k8425.ACTID
where 
l.curr_ind = 'Y'
and l.received_date>= cast( date_sub(date_trunc((current_date()-7),YEAR), interval 1 year) as timestamp)
--and --sl.service_line_code <> 'WDIR' including WDIR as of 12-11-2023 Rob Fuller's request
--and cancel_date is null
and abu.BU_type = 'Branch'

)
;

end

BEGIN

create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RAP_Portfolio_History` as 

WITH
  cte AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    branch_code,
    lob,
    --line_item,
    --cognos_code,
    --bucket,
    yearmonth,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'beginning_value' THEN value
  END
    AS beginning_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'new_value' THEN value
  END
    AS new_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'additions_value' THEN value
  END
    AS additions_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'NA' THEN value
  END
    AS NA,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'price' THEN value
  END
    AS price,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'adjustments_value' THEN value
  END
    AS adjustments_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'terminations_value' THEN value
  END
    AS terminations_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'deductions_value' THEN value
  END
    AS deductions_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'ending_value' THEN value
  END
    AS ending_value,
    CASE
      WHEN bucket = 'acquisitions_value' THEN value
  END
    AS acquisitions_value
  FROM
    `bidata-sharedus-dev.S2.RAP_Portfolio_History` )
SELECT
  district,
  branch_code,
  lob,
  yearmonth,
  SUM(beginning_value) AS beginning_value,
  SUM( new_value) AS new_value,
  SUM( additions_value) AS additions_value,
 -- SUM(NA) AS NA,
  SUM(price) AS price,
  SUM(adjustments_value) AS adjustments_value,
  SUM(terminations_value) AS terminations_value,
  SUM(deductions_value) AS deductions_value,
  SUM(ending_value) AS ending_value,
  SUM(acquisitions_value) AS acquisitions_value
FROM
  cte
GROUP BY
  district,
  branch_code,
  lob,
  yearmonth
;

--`bidata-sharedus-dev.S2.RAP_Portfolio_History` is directly connected to a google sheet https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hE-MuoJAVDo3x7Csq0KmxOxXJ8hAcHOlM5CPwcbVacs/edit#gid=0
end

BEGIN

create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S4_Jedox.Portfolio_Snp_Na_Daily_Dnm`

AS(--this is the denormalized reporting view for Jedox

-- TMX beginning_value 
with cte as (
SELECT 
  src_system,
  extract(year from (snp_date))*100 + extract(month from (snp_date))  as yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob,
  sum(annual_value) as beginning_value,
  sum(units) as beginning_units,
  sum(null) as terminations_value,
  sum(null) as terminations_units,
  sum(null) as deductions,
  sum(null) as deductions_units,
  sum(null) as additions,
  sum(null) as additions_units,
  sum(null) as price,
  sum(null) as new_value,
  sum(null) as new_units,
  sum(null) as acquisitions,
  sum(null) as acquisitions_units,
  sum(null) as adjustments,
  sum(null) as adjustments_units,
  sum(null) as ending_value,
  sum(null) as ending_units
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly`  p
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` s on p.service_code = s.service_line_code
group by src_system,
  yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob
  

union all 
--TMX ending value
SELECT 
  src_system,
  extract(year from (date_sub(cast(snp_date as datetime), interval 1 month)))*100 + extract(month from (date_sub(cast(snp_date as datetime), interval 1 month))) as yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob,
  sum(null) as beginning_value,
  sum(null) as beginning_units,
  sum(null) as terminations_value,
  sum(null) as terminations_units,
  sum(null) as deductions,
  sum(null) as deductions_units,
  sum(null) as additions,
  sum(null) as additions_units,
  sum(null) as price,
  sum(null) as new_value,
  sum(null) as new_units,
  sum(null) as acquisitions,
  sum(null) as acquisitions_units,
  sum(null) as adjustments,
  sum(null) as adjustments_units,
  sum(annual_value) as ending_value,
  sum(units) as ending_units 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly` 
group by src_system,
  yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob

union all

--TMX activities 
select 
  src_system,
  yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob,
  sum(null) as beginning_value,
  sum(null) as beginning_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as terminations_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as terminations_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as deductions,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as deductions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as additions,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as additions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'price' then activity_amount * report_multiplier  end) as price,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as `new`,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as new_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as acquisitions,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as acquisitions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' then activity_amount * report_multiplier end) as adjustments,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' then activity_quantity * report_multiplier end) as adjustments_units,
  sum(null) as ending_value,
  sum(null) as ending_units
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` d
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on d.activity_type = m.TMX_SA_activity_SID
--inner join removes activities that are currently out of scope
  where cast(activity_date as date) >= date_sub(current_date(), interval 26 month)
  group by src_system,
  customer_type,
  yearmonth,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob
)
select 
  src_system,
  cast(yearmonth as int) as yearmonth,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob,
  sum(beginning_value)as beginning_value,
  sum(beginning_units)as beginning_units,
  sum(terminations_value) as terminations_value,
  sum(terminations_units)as terminations_units,
  sum(deductions)as deductions_value,
  sum(deductions_units) as deductions_units,
  sum(additions)as additions_value,
  sum(additions_units)as additions_units,
  sum(price)as price,
  sum(new_value)as new_value,
  sum(new_units)as new_units,
  sum(acquisitions)as acquisitions_value,
  sum(acquisitions_units)as acquisitions_units,
  sum(adjustments) as adjustments_value,
  sum(adjustments_units) as adjustments_units,
  sum(ending_value) as ending_value,
  sum(ending_units) as ending_units
from cte
group by src_system,
  customer_type,
  branch_code,
  yearmonth,
  tenure,
  service_code,
  lob

 union all 

  --RNA prior months data

SELECT  
  'RPP' as src_system,
  cast(extract(year from (DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(AsOfDate, MONTH), INTERVAL 7 DAY)))*100 + extract(month from DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(AsOfDate, MONTH), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) as int) as yearmonth ,
  CustomerType  as customer_type,
  LEFT(CurrentDistrict,3) as branch_code,
  tenure,
  servicecode as service_code,
  lob_code as lob,
  sum(PreviousTotal) as beginning_value,
  sum(case when gainlossflag <> 'Sales' then 1 else 0 end) as beginning_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then NetChange end) as terminations_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then -1 else 0 end) as terminations_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then NetChange  end) as deductions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then -1 else 0  end) as deductions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then NetChange  end) as additions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then 1 else 0  end) as additions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'price' then NetChange  end) as price,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then NetChange  end) as new_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then 1 else 0  end) as new_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then NetChange  end) as acquisitions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then 1 else 0  end) as acquisitions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' then NetChange  end) as adjustments_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' and NetChange >=0 then 1 when  m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' and NetChange <0 then -1 else 0 end) as adjustments_units,
  sum(currentTotal) as ending_value,
  sum(case when  gainlossflag <> 'Termination' then 1 else 0 end) as ending_units
 --add a join to snap table to bring code
--ClassificationCode as class_code, 
--Zip as zip,
--NetChange as activity_amount
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RPP_Portfolio_Activity_Monthly`  p
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on BVStatusFlag =  SA_item_activity_name3 and m.TMX_SA_activity_SID >90
group by src_system,yearmonth, CustomerType, branch_code, servicecode, lob_code, tenure

union all 

 --RNA MTD data

SELECT  
  'RPP' as src_system,
  cast(extract(year from (DATE_TRUNC(AsofDate, MONTH)))*100 + extract(month from DATE_TRUNC(AsofDate, MONTH)) as int) as yearmonth ,
  CustomerType  as customer_type,
  LEFT(CurrentDistrict,3) as branch_code,
  	case when date_diff(AsOfDate,cast(SetupAddDate as date),month) <=0 then "Neg or zero months" 
     when date_diff(AsOfDate,cast(SetupAddDate as date),month) =1  then "1 month" 
     when date_diff(AsOfDate,cast(SetupAddDate as date),month) <=60 then concat(cast(date_diff(AsOfDate,cast(SetupAddDate as date),month) as string), " months")
    else ">60 months" 
    end as tenure,
  servicecode as service_code,
  lob_code as lob,
  sum(PreviousTotal) as beginning_value,
  sum(case when gainlossflag <> 'Sales' then 1 else 0 end) as beginning_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then NetChange end) as terminations_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'terminations' then -1 else 0 end) as terminations_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then NetChange  end) as deductions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'deductions' then -1 else 0  end) as deductions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then NetChange  end) as additions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'additions' then 1 else 0  end) as additions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'price' then NetChange  end) as price,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then NetChange  end) as new_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'new' then 1 else 0  end) as new_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then NetChange  end) as acquisitions_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'acquisitions' then 1 else 0  end) as acquisitions_units,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' then NetChange  end) as adjustments_value,
  sum(case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' and NetChange >=0 then 1 when  m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = 'adjustments' and NetChange <0 then -1 else 0 end) as adjustments_units,
  sum(currentTotal) as ending_value,
  sum(case when  gainlossflag <> 'Termination' then 1 else 0 end) as ending_units
 --add a join to snap table to bring code
--ClassificationCode as class_code, 
--Zip as zip,
--NetChange as activity_amount
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RPP_Portfolio_Activity_Daily`  p
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on BVStatusFlag =  SA_item_activity_name3  and m.TMX_SA_activity_SID >90
group by src_system,yearmonth, CustomerType, branch_code, servicecode, lob_code, tenure


union all 

--RNA Iris national accounts

select 
src_system, 
cast( yearmonth as int) as yearmonth, 
case market_type when "R" then "RES" when "C" then "COM" when "N" then "NAT" else market_type end as customer_type, 
cast(district as string) as branch_code, 
case when date_diff(snp_date,contract_date,month) <=0 then "Neg or zero months" 
     when date_diff(snp_date,contract_date,month) =1  then "1 month" 
     when date_diff(snp_date,contract_date,month) <=60 then concat(cast(date_diff(snp_date,contract_date,month) as string), " months")
    else ">60 months" 
    end as tenure,
svc_code as service_code,
cast (lob as string) as lob,
start as beginning_value, 
start_units as  beginning_units, 
terminations as terminations_value , 
terminations_units as terminations_units , 
deductions as deductions_value, 
deductions_units as deductions_units,  
additions as additions_value, 
additions_units, 
price_increase as price, 
`new` as new_value, 
new_units as new_units, 
aquisitions as aquisitions_value, 
aquisitions_units, 
adjustments as adjustments_value, 
adjustments_units, 
`end` as ending_value, 
end_units as ending_units
from 
`bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly`


)
;

end

begin

declare row_count int64 ;

/*create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly`
partition by
date(`snp_date`)
AS(*/

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly`
 SELECT 
 	DISTINCT 
  'RIR'AS src_system, 
  concat(FOLCUSTID,'-',FOLWKST,'-',FOLWO_,'-',FOLLOB,FOLTOS,FOLSVC) AS contract_id, 
  cast(DATE_ADD(DATE(CAST(FOLYEAR AS int),CAST(FOLMONTH AS int),1), INTERVAL 1 month)as datetime)AS snp_date, 
  CURRENT_DATETIME() AS cre_date, 
  FOLYEAR *100 + FOLMONTH AS yearmonth, 
  safe.parse_date("%Y%j",cast(s.cwssaledt as string)) as contract_date, 
  FOLCUSTID as customerid, 
  FOLWKST AS location,
  FOLWO_ AS sales_wo_number,
  concat(FOLLOB,'-',FOLTOS,'-',FOLSVC) AS svc_code,
  FOLLOB as lob,
  FOLTOS as tos,
  FOLSVC as svc,
  FOLWKSTYPE as market_type,
  FOLDWADIST AS route_branch,
  FOLDWA AS route,
  FOLSVCSTSC AS service_status,
  FOLWKSTYPE AS location_type,
  FOLDIST_ as district,
  d.dstaddr1 AS business_unit, --FOLDIST_ -- this needs a join
  w.wkszip as zip,
  w.wkssiccode as class_code,
  FOLANNBILV AS start,
  case when FOLANNBILV > 0 then 1 
  	when  FOLANNBILV < 0 then -1 else 0 
  end as start_units,
  FOLPRCINCV + FOLCOBPRCV AS price_increase,
  FOLCOBVP + FOLACTADDV + FOLTAKENV AS additions,
  case when FOLACTADDV > 0 or FOLTAKENV > 0 then 1 
  	when FOLACTADDV > 0 and FOLTAKENV > 0 then 2 else 0 
  end as additions_units,
  - FOLCOBVN - FOLTRMREDC AS deductions,
  case when FOLTRMREDC <> 0 then -1 else 0 
  end as deductions_units,
  FOLNEWV AS `new`,
  case when FOLNEWV > 0 then 1 else 0 end as new_units,
  FOLREVALUP - FOLREVALDN + FOLREACTV + FOLADJV AS adjustments,
  case when FOLREACTV > 0 or FOLADJV > 0 then 1 
        when FOLREACTV > 0 and FOLADJV > 0 then 2
        when FOLADJV <0 then -1 else 0 
  end as adjustments_units,
  - FOLTERMV AS terminations,
  case when FOLTERMV > 0 then -1 
        when foltermv < 0 then 1 else 0
  end as terminations_units,
  FOLACQV AS aquisitions,
  case when  FOLACQV > 0 then 1
  	when  FOLACQV < 0 then -1 else 0
  end as aquisitions_units,
  FOLTRANV AS branch_change,
  case when  FOLTRANV > 0 then 1
  	when  FOLTRANV < 0 then -1 else 0 
  end as  branch_change_units,
  FOLPRCINCV + FOLCOBPRCV +FOLCOBVP + FOLACTADDV + FOLTAKENV - FOLCOBVN - FOLTRMREDC + FOLNEWV + FOLREVALUP - FOLREVALDN + FOLREACTV + FOLADJV - FOLTERMV + FOLACQV + FOLTRANV - FOLFINV AS netchange,
 ( FOLANNBILV + FOLPRCINCV + FOLCOBPRCV +FOLCOBVP + FOLACTADDV + FOLTAKENV - FOLCOBVN - FOLTRMREDC + FOLNEWV + FOLREVALUP - FOLREVALDN + FOLREACTV + FOLADJV - FOLTERMV + FOLACQV + FOLTRANV - FOLFINV ) AS `end`,
  case when ( FOLANNBILV + FOLPRCINCV + FOLCOBPRCV +FOLCOBVP + FOLACTADDV + FOLTAKENV - FOLCOBVN - FOLTRMREDC + FOLNEWV + FOLREVALUP - FOLREVALDN + FOLREACTV + FOLADJV - FOLTERMV + FOLACQV + FOLTRANV - FOLFINV )  > 0 then 1 else 0 end as end_units,
 FOLSTATUS AS rcdd_status,
 FOLCHGUSER AS rcd_user,
 FOLCHGDATE AS rcd_date,
 FOLCHGTIME AS rcd_time,
 s.cwscnrcode AS cancelreason_code,
 cnr.cnrdesc40 AS cancelreason_description,
 c.csmlstname AS customer_name
FROM
  `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.CWSFOLIOP` i 
  left join `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.CUSTMSP` c on i.FOLCUSTID = c.csmcustid 
  left join `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.DISTMSP` d on i.FOLDWADIST = d.dstdist_ 
  left join `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.WKSTMSP` w on i.FOLCUSTID = w.wkscust and i.FOLWKST = w.wkswkst and w.gcpactive = true  
  /*
	left join `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.CWSSVCMSP`  s  on i.FOLCUSTID = s.cwscustid and i.folwkst = s.cwswkst and i.folwo_ = s.cwswo_ and i.follob = s.cwslob and i.foltos = s.cwstos 
   				and i.district = cwsdist_ 
   	*/
left join (SELECT 
   					  cwscustid, 
   					  cwswkst , 
   					  cwswo_ , 
   					  cwslob, 
   					  cwstos, 
   					  cwssvc ,
   					  cwsdist_ , 
   					  cwscnrcode , 
   					  cwssaledt	, 
   					  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cwscustid, cwswkst , cwswo_ , cwslob, cwstos, cwssvc 
   					  --,cwsdist_ 
   				 	ORDER BY cwscustid, cwswkst , cwswo_ , cwslob, cwstos, cwssvc , 
   				 	---cwsdist_, 
   				 			gcpactive desc) as svcmsp_rn 		
   				 	from  
						`data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.CWSSVCMSP`
   				 	) AS s 
							on  i.FOLCUSTID = s.cwscustid 
							and i.folwkst = s.cwswkst 
							and i.folwo_ = s.cwswo_ 
							and i.follob = s.cwslob 
							and i.foltos = s.cwstos 
   							--and i.FOLDIST_ = s.cwsdist_ 
   							and i.folsvc = s.cwssvc
					    	      and s.svcmsp_rn =   1										  						
   left join (SELECT cnrcode, cnrdesc40 ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cnrcode 
				ORDER By cnrcode,gcpactive desc) as rn 
				from  `data-shared-production.iris_PRODFLIB.CANRSNTBP` ) AS CNR on s.cwscnrcode = cnr.cnrcode and cnr.rn =1
-- folyear=2023 and folmonth=7
WHERE FOLYEAR *100 + FOLMONTH > (select max(yearmonth) from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly`)
;

set row_count = (SELECT @@row_count)
;

select

'snp_RIR_Portfolio_Monthly' as scheduled_query_name,

begin 
declare row_count int64 ;
/*create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` 
partition by
date(activity_date)
AS(*/
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily`  
SELECT
current_datetime as insert_date,
f.upd_date,
'TDW' as src_system,
i.actid as contract_activity_id,
i.sales_agreement_number as contract_id,
f.activity_date,
i.effective_date,
f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID as activity_type,
--sia.SA_item_activity_name1 IGNORE
sl.service_line_code as service_code, --guessing this will be used for mapping
ia.report_market_type as market_type,
b.BUNCOD_ID as business_unit,
ia.classification_code as class_code ,
ad.postal_code as zip,
case  when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = "price" then SUM(f.price_chg_amount) 
      else SUM(f.annual_value) 
end as activity_amount,
SUM(f.activity_quantity) as activity_quantity 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity_fact`  f
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i on f.TMX_SA_item_SID = i.TMX_SA_item_SID
--inner join TMX_SA_conversion c on f.TMX_SA_conversion_SID = c.TMX_SA_conversion_SID IGNORE
--inner join time t on f.activity_date_SID = t.TIME_SID IGNORE
inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b on f.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON f.tmx_sa_item_attributes_SID = ia.tmx_sa_item_attributes_sid
--joins that I added
left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad on f.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID 
 --inner join `S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity` sia on f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = sia.TMX_SA_activity_SID IGNORE
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
 /*exclude out of scope activities*/
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = m.TMX_SA_activity_SID  
WHERE 
-- f.activity_date_SID >= extract(year from (current_date()))*100 + 1 -- Commented as it was yyyymmdd with yyyymm and was pulling all records - 12/11/2024
f.activity_date_SID >= CAST(format_date('%Y%m%d', date_sub(DATE_TRUNC(current_date(), month),INTERVAL 1 month) ) AS int64) -- Added to pull 2 months data. Any duplicates removed at the end of this query
and
(
( f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 -- exclude collections
and ia.service_type_code <> 'SPC')
OR
(f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 and f.initial_value <> 0 and ia.service_type_code = 'SPC')
)
and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL')
AND ia.services_per_year > 0 --adding to resolve Pest 365 templates issue 06/20/24
and f.upd_date > (select max(upd_date) from bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_activity_detail)-- LEAVE OUT for initial load 0 but include for incremenatl stored procedure
GROUP BY
f.upd_date,
f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID,
f.TMX_SA_attributes_SID,
f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID,
f.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID,
f.local_currency_SID,
b.BUNCOD_ID,
f.activity_date,
i.effective_date,
i.sales_agreement_number,
--sia.SA_item_activity_name1,
sl.service_line_code,
ia.report_market_type,
ia.classification_code,
ad.postal_code,
i.actid,
m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification
;
