'TDW' as src_system
;
-- leave out for initial load but include for stored procedure
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.Procedures.tmx_portfolio_activity_detail_deletions` 
select * from (
select insert_date,	upd_date,	src_system,	contract_activity_id,	contract_id,	activity_date,	activity_type,	service_code,	market_type,	business_unit,	class_code,	zip,	activity_amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY contract_activity_id, activity_amount, activity_type, activity_date ORDER BY upd_date DESC ) as rn
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` 
)
where rn> 1
;

delete from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` 
where concat(contract_activity_id,upd_date,activity_type,activity_amount,insert_date) in  
  (
select concat(contract_activity_id,upd_date,activity_type,activity_amount,insert_date) from 
(
select
  contract_activity_id, activity_amount, activity_type, activity_date, upd_date, insert_date 
  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY contract_activity_id, activity_amount, activity_type, activity_date ORDER BY upd_date DESC ) as rn
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` 
) where rn> 1
)
;

end

begin
  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production`.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily     
  SELECT 
    current_datetime as insert_date,
    f.upd_date,
    'TDW' as src_system,
    i.actid as contract_activity_id,
    i.sales_agreement_number as contract_id,
    f.activity_date,
    i.effective_date,
    f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID as activity_type,
    --sia.SA_item_activity_name1 IGNORE
    sl.service_line_code as service_code, --guessing this will be used for mapping
    ia.report_market_type as market_type,
    b.BUNCOD_ID as business_unit,
    ia.classification_code as class_code ,
    ad.postal_code as zip,
    case when m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification = "price" then SUM(f.price_chg_amount) 
          else SUM(f.annual_value) 
    end as activity_amount,
    SUM(f.activity_quantity) as activity_quantity 
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_activity_fact` f
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i on f.TMX_SA_item_SID = i.TMX_SA_item_SID
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b on f.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON f.tmx_sa_item_attributes_SID = ia.tmx_sa_item_attributes_sid
  --joins that I added
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad on f.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID  
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
  /*exclude out of scope activities*/
  inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.Reference.unf_ref_Activity_Map` m on f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = m.TMX_SA_activity_SID 
  WHERE f.activity_date_SID >= 20231001 --extract(year from (current_date()))*100 + 1 
  and
  (  ( f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 -- exclude collections 
  and ia.service_type_code <> 'SPC') 
  OR
  (f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID <> 11 and f.initial_value <> 0 and ia.service_type_code = 'SPC')
  )
  and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL')
  AND ia.services_per_year > 0 --adding to resolve Pest 365 templates issue 06/20/24
  -- and f.upd_date > (select max(upd_date) from bidata-sharedus-production.S2.tmx_portfolio_activity_detail)-- LEAVE OUT for initial load 0 but include for incremenatl stored procedure
  ---AND i.sales_agreement_number = 32133482 
  AND 
  (
  --f.activity_date_SID between 20240101 and 20240530 and
  i.raw_sale_yn = 'N' 
  and i.billable_yn = 'Y' 
  and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL') 
  and b.BU_type in ('Branch','Satellite Branch')
  --and ac.SA_item_activity_name3 = 'New Pest Control'
  --AND f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = 13 
  ---and ac.report_classification in ('cancel','NEW')
  and sl.service_line1_short in ('PC','PM','TC')
  --AND i.sales_agreement_number NOT IN (SELECT contract_id FROM `bidata-sharedus-production`.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily WHERE activity_type = 13)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT contract_id FROM `bidata-sharedus-production`.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily b WHERE 
                  f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID = b.activity_type AND i.sales_agreement_number = b.contract_id 
                  AND i.actid = b.contract_activity_id AND CAST(f.activity_date_sid AS string) = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d',DATE(activity_date)))
  )
  GROUP BY
  f.upd_date,
  f.TMX_SA_item_activity_SID,
  f.TMX_SA_attributes_SID,
  f.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID,
  f.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID,
  f.local_currency_SID,
  b.BUNCOD_ID,
  f.activity_date,
  i.effective_date,
  i.sales_agreement_number,
  --sia.SA_item_activity_name1,
  sl.service_line_code,
  ia.report_market_type,
  ia.classification_code,
  ad.postal_code,
  i.actid,
  m.Phase1_RNA_portfolio_classification ---) 
  ;
END

begin
  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_StartedNewBus_Daily`
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CURRENT_DATETIME() AS insert_date,
    p.activity_date AS upd_date,  
    p.src_system,
    p.contract_activity_id,
    p.contract_id,
    CAST(psc.Portfolio_startdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS activity_date, ---CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS activity_date,
    CAST(psc.Portfolio_startdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS effective_date, ---p.effective_date,
    p.activity_type,
    p.service_code,
    p.market_type,
    p.business_unit,
    p.class_code,
    p.zip,
    p.activity_amount,
    p.activity_quantity
  FROM  
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_Daily` p 
  LEFT JOIN 
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` s ON p.service_code = s.service_line_code  
  LEFT JOIN 
    `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Current_Started` psc ON cast(p.contract_id as STRING)= psc.contract_id and p.service_code = psc.service_code         
  WHERE 
    s.service_line1_short <> 'TC' 
    AND activity_type = 13  
    AND CONCAT(p.contract_id, "-", p.service_code) IN (
      SELECT 
        CONCAT(ps.contract_id, "-", ps.service_code)
      FROM 
        `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.Vw_TDW_Portfolio_Current_Started` ps
    )
    AND CONCAT(p.contract_id, "-", p.service_code) NOT IN (
      SELECT 
        CONCAT(cs.contract_id, "-", cs.service_code)
      FROM 
        `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Activity_StartedNewBus_Daily` cs
    );
end

BEGIN
  DECLARE row_count INT64;
  DECLARE snap_date DATE;
  SET snap_date = DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY);

  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Current`
  SELECT 
    'TDW' AS src_system,
    CAST(DATE_ADD(snap_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS TIMESTAMP) AS snp_date,
    CURRENT_DATETIME AS insert_date,
    sales_agreement_number AS contract_id,
    i.effective_date,
    sl.service_line_code AS service_code, 
    ia.report_market_type AS market_type,
    b.BUNCOD_ID AS business_unit,
    ia.classification_code AS class_code,
    ad.postal_code AS zip,
    SUM(annual_value) AS annual_value,
    COUNT(*) AS base_quantity
  FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = ia.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
  INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl ON i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
  LEFT JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad ON i.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID 
  WHERE
    DATE_ADD(CAST(snap_date AS TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL 1 DAY) BETWEEN i.eff_date AND i.end_date 
    AND (CAST(snap_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN effective_date AND inactive_date) 
    AND (CAST(snap_date AS TIMESTAMP) < cancel_date OR cancel_date IS NULL) 
    AND i.raw_sale_yn = 'N' 
    AND i.billable_yn = 'Y'
    AND ia.service_type_code IN ('BIT','REG','RNL')
    AND ia.services_per_year > 0 --adding to resolve Pest 365 templates issue 06/20/24 
  GROUP BY
    ACTID, 
    sales_agreement_number,
    i.effective_date,
    sl.service_line_code,
    ia.report_market_type,
    b.BUNCOD_ID,
    ia.classification_code,
    ad.postal_code,
    b.BUNCOD_ID;

  SET row_count = (SELECT @@row_count);

  INSERT INTO `bidata-sharedus-production.Procedures.scheduled_query_logs`
  SELECT	
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
    'snp_TDW_Portfolio_Current' AS scheduled_query_name,
    'Portfolio' AS subject_area,
    row_count AS insert_row_count,
    'bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Current' AS destination_table,
    'TDW' AS src_system;
END

begin

declare row_count int64 ;
declare snap_date date;
set snap_date =  DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(date_sub(current_date(), interval 5 day), month),interval  1 month), interval 1 day);--'2023-01-31'; set to last day of month completed
 --create or replace table `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly`  -
insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly` -- use this for sp
SELECT 
'TDW' as src_system,
cast(date_add(snap_date, interval 1 day) as timestamp) as snp_date,
current_datetime as insert_date,
sales_agreement_number as contract_id,
i.effective_date,
sl.service_line_code as service_code, 
ia.report_market_type as market_type,
b.BUNCOD_ID as business_unit,
ia.classification_code as class_code,
ad.postal_code as zip,
SUM(annual_value) AS annual_value,
COUNT(*) AS base_quantity
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item` i
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_attributes` ia ON i.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID = ia.TMX_SA_item_attributes_SID
INNER JOIN `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_business_unit` b ON i.assigned_BUnit_SID = b.TMX_business_unit_SID
 inner join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_sa_item_service_line` sl on i.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID = sl.TMX_SA_item_service_line_SID
 left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S0_TMX.tmx_address` ad on i.TMX_address_SID = ad.TMX_address_SID 

WHERE
date_add(cast(snap_date as timestamp), interval 1 day) between i.eff_date and i.end_date and 
(cast(snap_date as timestamp) between effective_date and inactive_date) and
(cast(snap_date as timestamp) < cancel_date or cancel_date is null) and
i.raw_sale_yn = 'N' and
i.billable_yn = 'Y'
-- and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT','REG','RNL') --Commented 05/19/2025 for Sentricon BIT billable Y to N
and 
( (sl.service_line1_short = 'TC' and ia.service_type_code in ('REG','RNL') ) 
  or (sl.service_line1_short <> 'TC' and ia.service_type_code in ('BIT', 'REG', 'RNL') ) 
  ) -- Added 05/19/2025 for Sentricon BIT billable Y to N
AND ia.services_per_year > 0 --adding to resolve Pest 365 templates issue 06/20/24

GROUP BY
ACTID, 
sales_agreement_number,
i.effective_date,
sl.service_line_code,
ia.report_market_type,
b.BUNCOD_ID,
ia.classification_code,
ad.postal_code,
b.BUNCOD_ID
;

set row_count = (SELECT @@row_count);

insert into `bidata-sharedus-production.Procedures.scheduled_query_logs`
select	
current_timestamp(),
'snp_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly' as scheduled_query_name,

row_count as insert_row_count	,
'bidata-sharedus-production.S2.snp_TDW_Portfolio_Monthly' as destination_table,

;

begin

/* Copy Mission data  */

insert into bidata-sharedus-production.S1.stg_MSN_AppointmentDetail_Hourly
(  Source
  ,WorkOrder
  ,EmployeeId 
  ,WorkOrderStatus
  ,ActualTimeStart
  ,ActualTimeEnd
  ,ActualDuraton   )
select  distinct
   'MSN' as Source
   ,ACTTACTID as WorkOrder
   ,ACTEMPNUC as EmployeeId   
   ,' ' as WorkOrderStatus

  ,concat(substr(ACTFDTE,1,4), '-'
  ,substr(ACTFDTE,5,2), '-'
  ,substr(ACTFDTE,7,2),' '
  ,case
    when actftim = '0' 
      then '00'
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 1 and ACTFTIM != '0' 
      then '00'
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 2 
      then '00'
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 3 
      then concat('0',substr(ACTFTIM,1,1))   
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 4 
      then substr(ACTFTIM,1,2) 
    else '00' end, ':' 
  ,case
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 1 
      then concat('0',substr(ACTFTIM,1,1)) 
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 2 
      then substr(ACTFTIM,1,2)
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 3 
      then substr(ACTFTIM,2,2)   
    when length(ACTFTIM) = 4
      then substr(ACTFTIM,3,2)
        else '00'  end, 
  ':00' ) as ActualTimeStart 

    ,concat(substr(ACTTDTE,1,4), '-'
    ,substr(ACTTDTE,5,2), '-'
    ,substr(ACTTDTE,7,2),' '
    ,case
      when ACTTTIM = '0' 
        then '00'
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 1 and ACTTTIM != '0' 
        then '00'
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 2 
        then '00'
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 3 
        then concat('0',substr(ACTTTIM,1,1))   
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 4 
        then substr(ACTTTIM,1,2) 
      else '00' end, ':' 
    ,case
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 1 
        then concat('0',substr(ACTTTIM,1,1)) 
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 2 
        then substr(ACTTTIM,1,2)
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 3 
        then substr(ACTTTIM,2,2)   
      when length(ACTTTIM) = 4
        then substr(ACTTTIM,3,2)
          else '00'  end, 
    ':00' ) as ActualTimeEnd  
    ,ACTDUR as ActualDuraton
from bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_MSN_AppointmentDetail_Hourly
where  date(concat(substr(ACTFDTE,1,4), '-'
          ,substr(ACTFDTE,5,2), '-'
          ,substr(ACTFDTE,7,2))) = date(current_date()) and
        ACTTACTID in(
          select T1.ACTTACTID
            from bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_MSN_AppointmentDetail_Hourly T1 
              left join bidata-sharedus-production.S1.stg_MSN_AppointmentDetail_Hourly T2  
                on t1.ACTTACTID = T2.WorkOrder 
                  --and T1.ACTFDTE = concat(substring(T2.ActualTimeStart,1,4), 
                  --substring(T2.ActualTimeStart,6,2), substring(T2.ActualTimeStart,8,2))
          where (T2.WorkOrder is null and T2.ActualTimeStart is null)
                  -- OR (T1.ACTTACTID = T2.ACTTACTID and Date(T2.ActualTimeStart) != date(current_date())) 
        );

--TRUNCATE TABLE bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_MSN_AppointmentDetail_Hourly;

/* Copy RPM data  */

insert into bidata-sharedus-production.S1.stg_RPM_AppointmentDetail_Hourly
(  Source
  ,WorkOrder
  ,ACTEMPNUC 
  ,WorkOrderStatus
  ,ActualTimeStart
  ,ActualTimeEnd
  ,ActualDuration   )
select distinct
   'MSN' as Source
   ,WorkOrder as WorkOrder
   ,ACTEMPNUC as ACTEMPNUC  
   ,' ' as WorkOrderStatus
   ,ActualTimeStart 
   ,ActualTimeEnd  
   ,ActualDuration as ActualDuration
from bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPM_AppointmentDetail_Hourly
where  date(ActualTimeStart) = date(current_date()) and
        WorkOrder in(
          select T2.WorkOrder
            from bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPM_AppointmentDetail_Hourly T1 
              join bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPM_AppointmentDetail_Hourly T2  
                on t1.WorkOrder = T2.WorkOrder 
                  and T1.ActualTimeStart = T2.ActualTimeStart
          where T2.WorkOrder is null) ;

TRUNCATE TABLE bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPM_AppointmentDetail_Hourly;
end

begin
insert into bidata-sharedus-production.S1.stg_MSN_Appointment_Daily
(  source
  ,BranchCd
  ,WorkOrder
  ,MSNSequence
  ,RouteSequence
  ,ApptDate
  ,EmployeeId
  ,EmployeeName
  ,workorderstatus
  ,ApptStatus
  ,ApptWindowBegindateTime
  ,ApptWindowEndDateTime
  ,Duration
  ,DurationQualifier
  ,SalesAgreementNumber
  ,MarketType
  ,TerritoryCode
  ,ServiceType
  ,LastModifiedDateTime
  ,UTCOffset
  ,SnapShotDateTime    )
select 
   Source
  ,BRANCHCD as BranchCD
  ,WORKORDER AS WorkOrder
  ,Sequence as MSNSequence
  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY EmployeeId order by BranchCd, EmployeeId,APPTWINDOWBEGINTIME, 
      safe_cast(Sequence as int64)) as RouteSequence
  ,Date(concat(safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),1,4) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),5,2) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),7,2) as int64))) as ApptDate
  ,Safe_Cast(EMPLOYEEID as int64) as EmployeeId
  ,EMPLOYEENAME as EmployeeName
  ,WORKORDERSTATUS as WorkOrderStatus
  ,APPTSTATUS as ApptStatus
  ,timestamp(concat(safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),1,4) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),5,2) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINDATE as string),7,2) as int64), 'T'
  ,case
    when length(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINTIME as string)) = 3 then
        concat('0',substr(safe_cast(ApptWindowBeginTime as string),1,1))   
        else substr(safe_cast(ApptWindowBeginTime as string),1,2) end, ':' 
  ,case
    when length(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWBEGINTIME as string)) = 3 then
        substr(safe_cast(ApptWindowBeginTime as string),2,2)   
        else substr(safe_cast(ApptWindowBeginTime as string),3,2) end, ':'
  ,'00'  )) as ApptWindowBeginDateTime  
  ,timestamp(concat(safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDDATE as string),1,4) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDDATE as string),5,2) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDDATE as string),7,2) as int64), 'T'
  ,case
    when length(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string)) = 3 then
        concat('0',substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string),1,1))   
        else substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string),1,2) end, ':' 
  ,case
    when length(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string)) = 3 then
        substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string),2,2)   
        else substr(safe_cast(APPTWINDOWENDTIME as string),3,2) end, ':'
  ,'00'  )) as ApptWindowEndDateTime  
  ,DURATION as Duration
  ,DURATIONQUALIFIER as DurationQualifier
  ,SALESAGREEMENTNUMBER as SalesAgreementNumber
  ,MARKETTYPE as MarketType
  ,TERRITORYCODE as TerritoryCode
  ,SERVICETYPE as ServiceType
  ,timestamp(concat(safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDDATE as string),1,4) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDDATE as string),5,2) as int64), '-'
  ,safe_cast(substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDDATE as string),7,2) as int64), ' '
 ,case
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 5 then
        concat('0',substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),1,1)) 
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 6 then 
        substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),1,2)
    else '00' end, ':' 
  ,case
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 3 then
        concat('0', substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),1,1)) 
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 4 then
        substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),1,2)   
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 5 then
        substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),2,2)   
    when length(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string)) = 6 then    
        substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),3,2) 
    else substr(safe_cast(LASTMODIFIEDTIME as string),1,2) end, ':'
  ,'00'  )) as LastModifiedDateTime
  ,UTCOFFSET as UTCOffset
  ,SNAPSHOTDATETIME as SnapShotDateTime
from `bidata-sharedus-production.S0.Raw_MSN_Appointment_Daily`
where APPTWINDOWBEGINTIME > 100 and APPTWINDOWENDTIME > 100 ;

begin

/*   RPP Import   */

truncate table `bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPP_Routes_Monthly` ;

insert into  `bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPP_Routes_Monthly` 
(SourceCode, RouteBranch, RouteYearMonth, RouteCode, AssignedRouteTech, CreateDate)
select 
 SourceCode
,case when RouteBranch is null then safe_cast(routeid as string) else RouteBranch end RouteBranch
,RouteYearMonth
,RouteCode
,AssignedRouteTech
,CreatedDate
from 
(select  'RPP' as SourceCode
        ,case when glsuffix is null then Current_State_Branch_Code else glsuffix end RouteBranch
        ,(EXTRACT(Year FROM CURRENT_DATE) * 100) + EXTRACT(Month FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS RouteYearMonth
        ,code as RouteCode
        ,defaulttechid as AssignedRouteTech
        ,CURRENT_DATE as CreatedDate
        ,rte.routeid
        ,defaultbranchid
from `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.Routes` rte
  left join `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.Branches` brch on rte.defaultbranchid = brch.branchid
  left join `bidata-sharedus-production.S2.VwUnf_Branch` unfbrnch on unfbrnch.Current_State_Branch_Code = safe_cast(rte.defaultbranchid as string)

  
);

truncate table `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.raw_RPP_RouteEmp_Monthly` ;

insert into  `bidata-sharedus-production.S1.raw_RPP_RouteEmp_Monthly`
(SourceCode, RouteBranch, RouteYearMonth, RouteName, RouteTechID, RouteTechName, CreateDate)
SELECT 
       SourceCode
      ,safe_cast(RouteBranch as int64) as RouteBranch
      ,RouteYearMonth
      ,RouteCode as RouteName
      ,AssignedRouteTech
      ,concat(lname, ',', fname) as RouteTechName
      ,Date(CreateDate) 
FROM `bidata-sharedus-production.S0.raw_RPP_Routes_Monthly` rte
  left join `bidata-us-production.S1_PP.Employees` emp
      on rte.AssignedRouteTech = emp.employeeid;
